bbconemidlands.uk.title: Countryfile
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2026 Forest Green Rovers Vick Hope discovers how a team from a small Gloucestershire hamlet made it into the professional leagues, before trying her hand at mowing the pitch with the club's groundsman. Matt Baker follows the making of an organic beer and meets the greengrocer supplying fresh produce to the world's first fully vegan football club. Adam Henson heads to Yorkshire to find some fresh recruits for his White Park herd back in Gloucestershire.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Reluctant Vampire
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E5 Wilf suffers a hiccup transforming into a werewolf. When he goes missing, the vampires decide to disguise themselves as humans and venture into the village to try and rescue him. Val's worlds collide when Vernon leads them straight to Gertie's house, where her family are enjoying the annual celebrations of victories over the vampires.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Strictly Come Dancing: The Results
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S24 E12 Week 6 2026 Results It's fright night in the ballroom with the results of the Halloween spectacular - and for one week only, three couples go head to head in the dance-off, meaning the judges will be voting for the couple they want to eliminate. There's also music by Becky Hill and the professionals get their fangs out for a group routine dedicated to Dracula. Who will make it to the halfway point of the competition? And whose Halloween weekend will turn into a nightmare.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: This City Is Ours
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2 E3 Cheryl returns to Liverpool with devastating news for Michael. With no way out, Michael is forced to make an impossible decision to protect the one he loves. Meanwhile, tensions rise among the Phelans as they hunt Banksey, unaware a new enemy is moving in the shadows.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: BBC News at Ten
bbconemidlands.uk.description: E31 01/11/2026 A round-up of today's headlines.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Match of the Day : 01/11/2026
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Liverpool v Arsenal. Kelly Cates presents highlights of the Premier League match at Anfield. Liverpool prevailed 1-0 against the Gunners last term thanks to a stunning free-kick by Dominik Szoboszlai, but it was Arsenal who went on to win the league. Plus, a round-up of yesterday's action.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Merv
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Festive romantic comedy starring Zooey Deschanel and Charlie Cox. When Boston couple Anna and Russ break up, their dog Merv doesn't take it well, forcing the estranged lovers to share parenting duties. As Christmas approaches, Russ decides to improve Merv's mood by taking him to sunny Florida. Then, Anna turns up unexpectedly.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Graham Norton Show
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S34 E6 Together on Graham's sofa are double Oscar winner Michael Douglas, discussing his tell-all memoir, One Helluva Ride; Hollywood great Glenn Close and Succession star Kieran Culkin, together in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping; and British actor Naomi Ackie, starring in horror thriller Clayface. With music from Sugababes, performing their current single, Ghost.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's American Adventure
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E15 Baton Rouge The travelling chef ventures into Louisiana's state capital Baton Rouge to experience a unique American phenomenon - tailgating. It's the day of a big football match at Louisiana State University, and the LSU Tigers are playing in front of thousands of fans. Surrounded by people barbecuing, cooking and sharing food from the back of their pick-up trucks, James joins in and cooks up a storm ahead of the game. He also takes time out to visit a Baton Rouge-based oyster restaurant specialising in North American varieties.

talkingpictures.uk.title: Scotland Yard - Print of Death
talkingpictures.uk.description: A payroll van is pulled over by a police car - the guards shot and the payroll stolen. (Crime drama, Suspense) - 1957

talkingpictures.uk.title: That's My Boy - Friendship View to a Marriage
talkingpictures.uk.description: Mrs. Price and Wilfred come to visit. Wilfred tell's everyone that he's going to propose, but his attention gets diverted. (Sitcom) - 1985

talkingpictures.uk.title: For the Love of Ada - The Mortgage
talkingpictures.uk.description: Ada and Walter hear of a flat available for rent not too far from the church or from Leslie and Ruth's. (Sitcom) - 1971

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Man From U.N.C.L.E - The Dippy Blonde Affair
talkingpictures.uk.description: A daffy blonde (Joyce Jameson) decides to become an U.N.C.L.E. agent to avenge the death of her THRUSH beau. (Crime drama) - 1966

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Footage Detectives
talkingpictures.uk.description: Mike and Noel step back to 1947 with warnings for curious children, then it's off to Sweden for a little nostalgia from 1957 and the detectives talk fireworks '50s style and explosive escapades. (Mystery, Art, History) - 2026

talkingpictures.uk.title: Enemy at the Door - Officers of the Law
talkingpictures.uk.description: A boy will die without a new German drug; Kluge (John Malcolm) and a detective (John Nettles) scheme. (Drama, War) - 1978

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Bargee (1964)
talkingpictures.uk.description: The film charts the course of love of a Casanova who lives and works on the canals, breaking hearts. (Comedy) - 1964

talkingpictures.uk.title: Fox - The Perfect Scapegoat Syndrome
talkingpictures.uk.description: Following Billy Fox, an outwardly retired Covent Garden market porter living in Clapham with his family, who have gangland connections in London's East End. (Crime drama, Drama) - 1980

talkingpictures.uk.title: Runaway Train (1985)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Philosophical action thriller about two escaped prisoners who hide on board a train speeding through Alaska. The driver suffers a fatal heart attack and the train races out of control through the icy wilderness. With the railroad signalmen unable to stop it and a vindictive prison warden desperately pursuing them by helicopter, the train's passengers look set to face disaster. Based on a screenplay by Akira Kurosawa. (Action) - 1985

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Heritage Chart Show
talkingpictures.uk.description: A TOTP-style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

talkingpictures.uk.title: How To Undress in Public (1965)
talkingpictures.uk.description: Directed by Compton Bennett. Stars Fenella Fielding, Reginald Beckwith & Kenneth Connor. A comedic take on the different methods of undressing through the ages. (Comedy) - 1965

talkingpictures.uk.title: Richard's Things (1981)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood - Imposters

And in the Showstopper, it's eye-catching decorative pie pandemonium. (Competition reality)

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E1 — Kamp Krusty Bart forges his school report, so Homer will let him and Lisa go to Kamp Krusty for the summer, but the dream camp turns out to be a sweatshop and Bart leads an uprising. Meanwhile, with the kids away, Homer gets into the best shape of his life and love breaks out in the Simpson household. (Animation)

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S4 E2 — A Streetcar Named Marge Marge is cast as Blanche DuBois in a local musical production of 'A Streetcar Named Desire'. The show stinks, but Homer's crass comments inspire Marge to give the performance of a lifetime. (Animation)

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4+1.uk.description: S8 E17 — My Sister, My Sitter Bart tries everything he can to destroy Lisa's image as a dependable babysitter when she is left in charge. (Animation)

E4+1.uk.title: Christmas With the Kranks

(Film)

E4+1.uk.title: Jingle All the Way
E4+1.uk.description: Harassed businessman Howard tells his little boy he'll buy him a Turbo Man for Christmas, only to find that every store has sold out. Racing round the shops in search of the last toy, he realises that postman Myron is doing exactly the same thing. (Film)

E4+1.uk.title: The Great British Bake Off
E4+1.uk.description: S16 — The Great New Year Bake Off Four teams of 'Bake Off' bakers from past seasons ring in the New Year with three baking challenges. The duos create fantastic festive pies, pass the baton in a tricky Technical relay, and bring their favourite festive movie to life in biscuit form. (Competition reality)

E4+1.uk.title: One Born Every Minute
E4+1.uk.description: S12 E2 — Episode 2 Billie faces nerves after an 11-year gap. Maria and Paul prep for baby number two. And after a long IVF journey, Kate and Matt are ready to meet their daughter. (Documentary)

E4+1.uk.title: The Other Woman
E4+1.uk.description: New York lawyer Carly Whitten lives by strict rules when it comes to romantic relationships, but when she falls for suave, handsome Mark King, she begins an affair with him. A surprise visit to Mark's home reveals that he is married to devoted housewife Kate. Carly and Kate direct their hurt and anger toward Mark, and when they discover, yet a third woman caught in his web of lies, the three join forces for revenge. (Film)

E4+1.uk.title: Plan B

E4+1.uk.title: One Born Every Minute

amc.us.title: Halloween
amc.us.description: On a cold Halloween night in 1963, six-year-old Michael Myers brutally murdered his 17-year-old sister, Judith. He was sentenced and locked away for 15 years. But on October 30, 1978, while being transferred for a court date, a 21-year-old Michael Myers steals a car and escapes Smith's Grove. He returns to his quiet hometown of Haddonfield, Illinois, where he looks for his next victims. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1978

amc.us.title: Halloween 4: The Return of Michael Myers
amc.us.description: The apparently comatose Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur) is being transferred from one hospital to another, but he wakes up when the ambulance crew talk about his surviving niece, Jamie (Danielle Harris). After slaughtering his attendants, Myers sets out to find his one living relative who is, fortunately, being cared for by a kind and resourceful foster sister named Rachel (Ellie Cornell). Meanwhile, the ever-cautious Dr. Loomis (Donald Pleasence) remains on the killer's path. (Holiday, Horror) - 1988

amc.us.title: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
amc.us.description: After lying in a coma for a year, Michael Myers (Donald L. Shanks) awakens and stalks his way back to his small hometown in Illinois, intent on killing his niece, Jamie (Danielle Harris), who has been confined to a mental institution since Michael's last attempt to slay her. Suspecting a psychic link between Michael and Jamie, psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence) joins forces with Sheriff Ben Meeker (Beau Starr) and attempts to stop Michael's latest rampage. (Holiday, Horror) - 1989

amc.us.title: Christine
amc.us.description: Unpopular nerd Arnie Cunningham (Keith Gordon) buys a 1958 Plymouth Fury, which he names Christine. Arnie develops an unhealthy obsession with the car, to the alarm of his jock friend, Dennis Guilder (John Stockwell). After bully Buddy Repperton (William Ostrander) defaces Christine, the auto restores itself to perfect condition and begins killing off Buddy and his friends. Determined to stop the deaths, Dennis and Arnie's girlfriend, Leigh Cabot (Alexandra Paul), decide to destroy Christine. (Horror) - 1983

amc.us.title: The Terminator
amc.us.description: Disguised as a human, a cyborg assassin known as a Terminator (Arnold Schwarzenegger) travels from 2029 to 1984 to kill Sarah Connor (Linda Hamilton). Sent to protect Sarah is Kyle Reese (Michael Biehn), who divulges the coming of Skynet, an artificial intelligence system that will spark a nuclear holocaust. Sarah is targeted because Skynet knows that her unborn son will lead the fight against them. With the virtually unstoppable Terminator in hot pursuit, she and Kyle attempt to escape. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 1984

amc.us.title: Predator
amc.us.description: Dutch, a soldier of fortune, is hired by the U.S. government to secretly rescue a group of politicians trapped in Guatemala. But when Dutch and his team, which includes weapons expert Blain and CIA agent George, land in Central America, something is wrong. After finding a string of dead bodies, the crew discovers they are being hunted by a brutal creature with superhuman strength and the ability to disappear into its surroundings. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 1987

amc.us.title: Men in Black
amc.us.description: Working for a highly funded yet unofficial government agency, Kay and Jay are the Men in Black, providers of immigration services and regulators of all things alien on Earth. While investigating a series of unregistered close encounters, the MIB agents uncover the deadly plot of an intergalactic terrorist who is on a mission to assassinate two ambassadors from opposing galaxies currently in residence in New York City. (Action, Comedy, Science fiction, Adventure, Mystery) - 1997

amc.us.title: Men in Black II
amc.us.description: Kay and Jay reunite to provide our best line of defense against a seductress who levels the toughest challenge yet to the MIB's mission statement: protecting the earth from the scum of the universe. While investigating a routine crime, Jay uncovers a plot masterminded by Serleena, a Kylothian monster who disguises herself as a lingerie model. When Serleena takes the MIB building hostage, there is only one person Jay can turn to -- his former MIB partner. (Action, Comedy, Science fiction) - 2002

bether.us.description: Judge Ms. Pat settles cases that include a hairy situation between salon owner and stylist, a woman trying to hook her friend up with a catering job and a poor paint job that dried up a friendship. (Reality, Comedy, Law) - 2023-11-15

bether.us.title: Ms. Pat Settles It - Vacay for Babay?
bether.us.description: Judge Ms. Pat settles cases that include friends turned foes over a glam job, cousins disputing over a slip and fall situation and friends disputing over vacation payment in the form of a baby. (Reality, Comedy, Law) - 2023-11-22

bether.us.title: Ms. Pat Settles It - Livin' Aint Free
bether.us.description: Judge Ms. Pat settles cases that include an employee working for free, but the boss says she owes her, a mentor looking for his rent money but needs to clean up a messy lease agreement, and two sisters battle. (Reality, Comedy, Law) - 2023-11-29

bether.us.title: Ms. Pat Settles It - Don't Change Your Tune Now!
bether.us.description: Judge Ms. Pat settles cases that include an ex-husband whose ex-wife pulled a $5k fast one for her dream car, a mother suing her daughter over tax return money and a music manager promised a payback after her artist has changed. (Reality, Comedy, Law) - 2023-12-06

bether.us.title: Ms. Pat Settles It - Synthetic Shenanigans
bether.us.description: Judge Ms. Pat settles cases that include a friendship that came to a screeching halt at a reggae fest, exes who are at war over synthetic wigs and friends brawling over a bad boutique review. (Reality, Comedy, Law) - 2023-12-13

bether.us.title: Ms. Pat Settles It - You a Nasty Roomie!
bether.us.description: Judge Ms. Pat settles cases that include a roommate from hell and one nasty razor, an engaged couple whose trust issues get taken out on a car and a sister-in-law whose house-sitting causes a tsunami setback. (Reality, Comedy, Law) - 2023-12-20

bether.us.title: Ms. Pat Settles It - Shady Sister Swipe
bether.us.description: A roommate is more focused on romance than bromance; a little sister is stiffed by her sister; a couple clashes over a lost social media opportunity. (Reality, Comedy, Law) - 2024-05-29

bether.us.title: Ruined
bether.us.description: When her marriage hits a rough patch, Olivia seeks the help of a marriage counselor who has a secret plan to ruin her life to settle an old score. (Thriller) - 2023

bether.us.title: The Missing
bether.us.description: A year after Raina flees her abusive husband while pregnant, her baby daughter disappears, and she must take matters into her own hands. (Drama) - 2022

bether.us.title: Miles Ahead
bether.us.description: In the 1970s, down-and-out jazz trumpeter Miles Davis (Don Cheadle) tries to recover his new session tape from music producers. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Jazz, Drama) - 2016

bether.us.title: Glory
bether.us.description: Following the Battle of Antietam, Col. Robert Gould Shaw (Matthew Broderick) is offered command of the United States' first all-African-American regiment, the 54th Massachusetts Volunteer Infantry. With junior officer Cabot Forbes (Cary Elwes), Shaw puts together a strong and proud unit, including the escaped slave Trip (Denzel Washington) and the wise gravedigger John Rawlins (Morgan Freeman). At first limited to menial manual tasks, the regiment fights to be placed in the heat of battle. (War, Historical drama) - 1989

bether.us.title: Call Her King
bether.us.description: Judge Jaeda King has just sentenced Sean Samuels to death when the courthouse is hijacked by Samuels' brother Gabriel, also known as Black Caesar. The judge must rely on her wits, strength and skill to find a way to end the standoff. (Action, Thriller) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: A History of Violence
cinemax.us.description: Vicious criminals continue to harass a man (Viggo Mortensen) and his wife (Maria Bello) after he thwarts a robbery attempt at his diner. - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Hitchcock
cinemax.us.description: Alma Reville lends her customary support to husband Alfred Hitchcock as he directs "Psycho," but her reservations about the film's production cause a strain in their marriage. - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Enter Nowhere
cinemax.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Nerve
cinemax.us.description: Partnered with a mysterious stranger (Dave Franco), a high school senior (Emma Roberts) joins a popular online game that dares players to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Beasts of the Southern Wild
cinemax.us.description: The father of an intrepid youngster (Quvenzhané Wallis) prepares her for the end of the world, when melting ice caps release fearsome beasts, called aurochs, and rising floodwaters threaten to engulf their Delta home. - 2012

cinemax.us.title: The Hobbit
cinemax.us.description: An animated adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's tale of the adventures of a hobbit on a quest to regain a dwarf king's gold. - 1977

cinemax.us.title: Epic
cinemax.us.description: Magically transported to a secret realm, a teenage girl (Amanda Seyfried) joins an ongoing battle between the forces of good, which keep the natural world vital, and the forces of evil, which want to destroy it. - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Life of Pi
cinemax.us.description: After the freighter they're on sinks in a storm, a teenager (Suraj Sharma) and a Bengal tiger wind up on a small lifeboat and must learn to trust each other to survive. - 2012

cinemax.us.title: X-Men: First Class
cinemax.us.description: Charles Xavier and Erik Lehnsherr work with other mutants to prevent a nuclear nightmare, but a situation soon tears the close friends apart. - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Rampage
cinemax.us.description: When three different animals become infected with a dangerous pathogen, a primatologist and a geneticist team up to stop them from destroying Chicago. - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemax.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. - 2024

cinemax.us.title: The Meg
cinemax.us.description: A massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean. With time running out, a rescue diver must now confront an unimaginable threat, a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark. - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Batman
cinemax.us.description: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) saves dismal Gotham City and gorgeous Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger) from the freaky Joker (Jack Nicholson). - 1989

cinemax.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

cinemax.us.title: Batman & Robin
cinemax.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

cinemax.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

cinemax.us.title: Arctic
cinemax.us.description: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive. (Adventure, Drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Hoot
cinemax.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

cinemax.us.title: Take the Lead
cinemax.us.description: When internationally renowned dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a teaching job in a New York City public school, he meets ridicule from the street-wise students, who scoff at the notion of ballroom dancing. Far from being discouraged, he melds their hip-hop moves with his classical style, helping them create a dance form and, in the process, becoming their mentor. (Musical, Drama) - 2006

cinemax.us.title: Dumb Money
cinemax.us.description: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Comedy drama, Biography, Docudrama) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: Enemy
cinemax.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. (Thriller) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: The Adjustment Bureau
cinemax.us.description: Just as he is on the brink of winning a Senate seat, politician David Norris meets a ballerina named Elise Sellas. Though David is instantly smitten, mysterious men conspire to keep him away from the beautiful dancer. David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. (Thriller, Romance, Science fiction, Crime drama) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: The Nun
cinemax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: The Nun II
cinemax.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (Horror, Thriller) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: William Shakespeare's Romeo & Juliet
cinemax.us.description: Baz Luhrmann helped adapt this classic Shakespearean romantic tragedy for the screen, updating the setting to a post-modern city named Verona Beach. In this version, the Capulets and the Montagues are two rival gangs. Juliet is attending a costume ball thrown by her parents. Her father Fulgencio Capulet has arranged her marriage to the boorish Paris as part of a strategic investment plan. Romeo attends the masked ball and he and Juliet fall in love. (Romance, Drama) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
cinemax.us.description: When Austria's crown prince is found dead, evidence seems to point to suicide. However, detective Sherlock Holmes deduces that the prince was murdered and that the crime is but a piece of a puzzle designed by an evil genius named Moriarty. Holmes and his friend Dr. Watson, who are accompanied by a Gypsy whose life Holmes saved, chase Moriarty across Europe in the hope that they can thwart his plot before it can come to fruition. (Action, Adventure, Mystery) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Us
cinemax.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2019

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Dilemma
cinemaxaction.us.description: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out. (Comedy, Drama, Movie) - 2011-01-13

cinemaxaction.us.title: Girls Trip
cinemaxaction.us.description: Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. (Adventure, Comedy, Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2017-07-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Player
cinemaxaction.us.description: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1992-04-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Inconceivable
cinemaxaction.us.description: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter. Enduring lies and manipulations, Angela and her husband realize that sweet Katie is actually trying to destroy their family from within. (Crime, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2017-06-30

cinemaxaction.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
cinemaxaction.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (Documentary, Drama, Movie, Western) - 2024-05-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: Little Shop of Horrors
cinemaxaction.us.description: Meek flower shop assistant Seymour (Rick Moranis) pines for co-worker Audrey (Ellen Greene). During a total eclipse, he discovers an unusual plant he names Audrey II, which feeds only on human flesh and blood. The growing plant attracts a great deal of business for the previously struggling store. After Seymour feeds Audrey's boyfriend, Orin (Steve Martin), to the plant after Orin's accidental death, he must come up with more bodies for the increasingly bloodthirsty plant. (Comedy, Horror, Movie, Musical comedy) - 1986-12-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: Holla
cinemaxaction.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. (Comedy, Horror, Movie) - 2006

cinemaxaction.us.title: Men
cinemaxaction.us.description: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest. (Fantasy, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2022-05-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Nun II
cinemaxaction.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2023-09-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Transporter Refueled
cinemaxaction.us.description: Frank Martin is living a less perilous lifestyle, or so he thinks, transporting classified packages for questionable people. Things get complicated when femme fatale Anna and her three accomplices orchestrate a bank heist and the kidnapping of Frank's father. It's all part of a grand plan to take down the human trafficker who victimized her years earlier. Now a pawn in her vengeful scheme, the former special-operations mercenary must use his covert skills to play Anna's dangerous game. (Action, Crime, Movie, Thriller) - 2015-06-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: Nerve
cinemaxaction.us.description: Industrious high school senior Vee Delmonico (Emma Roberts) is tired of living life on the sidelines. Pressured by her friends, Vee decides to join Nerve, a popular online game that challenges players to accept a series of dares. It's not long before the adrenaline-fueled competition requires her to perform increasingly dangerous stunts. When Nerve begins to take a sinister turn, Vee finds herself in a high-stakes finale that will ultimately determine her entire future. (Action, Adventure, Crime, Crime drama, Movie) - 2016-07-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Tomb Raider
cinemaxaction.us.description: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 2018-03-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Atomic Blonde
cinemaxaction.us.description: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies. (Action, LGBTQ, Movie, Thriller) - 2017-07-28

cinemaxaction.us.title: Kingsman: The Golden Circle
cinemaxaction.us.description: With their headquarters destroyed and the world held hostage, members of Kingsman find new allies when they discover a spy organization in the United States known as Statesman. In an adventure that tests their strength and wits, the elite secret agents from both sides of the pond band together to battle a ruthless enemy and save the day, something that's becoming a bit of a habit for Eggsy. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 2017-09-22

cinemaxaction.us.title: Chasing Mavericks
cinemaxaction.us.description: When 15-year-old surfing phenomenon Jay Moriarty discovers that the mythic Mavericks surf break, one of the biggest waves on Earth, actually exists near his California home, he becomes determined to conquer it. Jay enlists the aid of local surfing legend Frosty Hesson to train him to ride the Mavericks and live to tell about it. As Jay and Frosty carry on their quest to achieve the impossible, they develop a unique friendship that transforms both their lives. (Adventure, Docudrama, Drama, Movie) - 2012-10-26

cinemaxaction.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Adventure, Comedy, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2025-01-31

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla
cinemaxaction.us.description: A U.S. newsman (Raymond Burr) in Tokyo recounts the story of a huge dinosaur roused from the sea by an atomic blast. (Movie, Science fiction) - 1956-04-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla, King of the Monsters!
cinemaxaction.us.description: A U.S. newsman (Raymond Burr) in Tokyo recounts the story of a huge dinosaur roused from the sea by an atomic blast. (Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1956-04-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla Raids Again
cinemaxaction.us.description: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan. (Action, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1955-04-24

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemaxaction.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Crime, Movie, Thriller) - 1960-08-10

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemaxaction.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2001-12-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemaxaction.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2004-12-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxaction.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2007-06-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ocean's Eight
cinemaxaction.us.description: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Crime drama, Movie) - 2018-06-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
cinemaxaction.us.description: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2018-03-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Predator
cinemaxaction.us.description: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and a disgruntled science teacher can prevent the end of the human race. (Action, Adventure, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2018-09-06

(Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

cinemaxwest.us.title: Batman
cinemaxwest.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

cinemaxwest.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemaxwest.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

cinemaxwest.us.title: Batman & Robin
cinemaxwest.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

cinemaxwest.us.title: Batman Forever

As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

cinemaxwest.us.title: Dumb Money

In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock. When his social media posts start blowing up, so does his life and the lives of everyone following him. As a stock tip becomes a movement, everyone gets wealthy -- until the billionaires fight back and both sides find their worlds turned upside down. (Comedy drama, Biography, Docudrama) - 2023

David learns that he is facing the powerful agents of Fate itself, and glimpsing the future laid out for him, must either accept a predetermined path that does not include Elise or else defy Fate to be with her. cookingchannel.us.title: The Best Thing I Ever Ate - Wake Up Call

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Hot Dogs, Hot Knots, and Hot Ramen
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy's tasting high-octane hot dogs, Buffalo knots, and noodle bowls.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Southeast Standouts
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri's on a tour of the Southeast, starting with an out-of-bounds brisket po'boy in Port Allen, LA; then, Guy finds shrimp rolls in Gainesville, Fla.; a Korean-Mexican mashup in Atlanta is rocking big-time bulgogi cheesesteaks.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - From Vietnamese to Vegan
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri visits restaurants with diverse cuisines: he tries Balinese chicken thighs at a Southeast Asian restaurant in Minneapolis and BBQ Reubens at a New Jersey restaurant; a couple prepares plant-based dishes in Montana.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri checks out the Phoenix food scene and visits an Irish pub that incorporates Southwestern style; he explores a family joint that serves smoke and spice wood-fired pizza and a neighborhood taquería that aims to redefine Mexican street food.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Funky Flavors
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy Fieri is getting into the funkiest of flavors; in Atlanta, two pals are serving up prime-time patty melt empanadas and a bakery in Los Angeles is plating craveable khachapuri.

foodnetwork.us.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives - Funkalicious
foodnetwork.us.description: Guy's getting funky with jerk chicken, duck confit banh mi, and more.

foodnetwork.us.title: Carnival Eats - Hogs and Dogs
foodnetwork.us.description: Noah arrives at The Great Frederick Fair in Maryland, where he enjoys the Whole Hog, the Crabby Dog and the Cake-a-Dilla; Noah visits New York's Wyoming County Fair and samples the Monster Veggie Wrap, the Mexita and the Exploding Fireball Taffy.

foodnetwork.us.title: Carnival Eats - Feast and Fries
foodnetwork.us.description: Noah visits the Paris Fair in Ontario, Canada for Her Majesty's Feast, meat pie poutine, the Dirtburger and Maddy Moo's Wrap Attack; the Washington County Fair in New York for Sugar Shack cotton candy, Bleu Ribbon Fries and the Twisted S'More.

foodnetwork.us.title: Delicious Miss Brown - Drive-Thru Redo
foodnetwork.us.description: Kardea makes a double patty veggie burger with a special sauce that goes perfectly with oven-baked onion rings; she also makes a baked apple hand pie and chocolate fro-yo shake for dessert.

foodnetwork.us.title: Delicious Miss Brown - Bridge Run Brunch
foodnetwork.us.description: After a bridge run workout with friends, Kardea Brown invites everyone back to her house for brunch; seafood omelet bar with all the fixings, candied bacon, peaches and cream scones, and refreshing sparkling mimosas.

foodnetwork.us.title: Delicious Miss Brown - Jazzed Up Supper Club
foodnetwork.us.description: Kardea Brown throws together a jazz-inspired supper club with chef Alexander Smalls; the menu includes fish chowder, grilled lamb chops with pink peppercorn sauce, fried skillet corn salad and red wine poached pears with vanilla bean custard.

foodnetwork.us.title: Delicious Miss Brown - Kardea's Spooktacular Party
foodnetwork.us.description: Kardea Brown hosts Halloween in her new home and throws an all-out party for her friends and family; with a menu featuring pepperoni mummy stromboli, sheet pan tomato soup, Jack-o'-Lantern jambalaya stuffed peppers, and graveyard ice cream pie.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Pioneer Woman - Tasty Treats to Go
foodnetwork.us.description: Pumpkin cinnamon rolls; sticky sweet baklava; white chocolate shortbread cookies; chocolate-dipped strawberries.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Pioneer Woman - Special Day
foodnetwork.us.description: Fun treats for a late-afternoon picnic, including animal crackers, crunchy cereal chicken fingers, cucumber finger sandwiches, salad on a stick and watermelon mini wedges.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Pioneer Woman - No Fail Fall
foodnetwork.us.description: Ree Drummond cooks some no-fail fall favorites, starting with an autumn steak salad and a one-pan fall chicken skillet, then, she prepares Santa Fe eggs in purgatory for an all-day breakfast and her quick mini chocolate tarts.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Pioneer Woman - Chocolate Memories
foodnetwork.us.description: Ree takes a trip down memory lane by sharing chocolate recipes that are special to her. She makes chocolate cake with 7-minute frosting, chocolate rice pudding, Ree's chocolate cereal treats, and the best mini chocolate chip cookies.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Kitchen - Spooky Surprises
foodnetwork.us.description: Treats for Halloween; Jeff Mauro's monster mac and cheese; Katie Lee's butternut squash soup; frightening food crafts; pass the cauldron cake; the piece of cake Halloween party is packed with great ideas and a Shirley Temple of doom.

foodnetwork.us.title: The Kitchen: World on a Plate ᴺᵉʷ
foodnetwork.us.description: The Kitchen makes delicious bites inspired by countries all over the world.

foodnetwork.us.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten - Yotam Ottolenghi
foodnetwork.us.description: Garten welcomes award-winning chef Dan Barber for lively conversation about catering coincidences, high-pressure hospitality, and redefining restaurant reviews. Plus, Ina makes Cornmeal Pound Cake, and Dan shares his recipe for Miso Crusted Squash.

foodnetwork.us.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten - Christina Tosi
foodnetwork.us.description: Pastry chef and Milk Bar founder Christina Tosi joins Ina Garten to share stories about life-changing career decisions and dessert revelations; Ina makes Smoked Salmon Tartines, and Christina shares the secrets to Milk Bar's legendary Birthday Cake.

foodnetwork.us.title: Halloween Wars - Back from the Dead: Misfit Monsters
foodnetwork.us.description: Bennett asks the teams to go head-to-head with terrifying trolls, demons and ghouls. But as rivalries heat up and tensions rise, one team faces an emotional fight to impress judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller enough to stay in the competition.

foodnetwork.us.title: Halloween Wars - Back from the Dead: Storybook Nightmares
foodnetwork.us.description: Twisted bedtime stories come to life as Jonathan Bennett asks the five remaining teams to create terrifying moving showpieces inspired by classic tales; judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller decide which team's story has come to an end.

foodnetwork.us.title: Halloween Wars - Back from the Dead: Nightmare Pet Shop
foodnetwork.us.description: Monstrous pets take over as Jonathan Bennett challenges the teams to create haunted pet shop showpieces and pumpkin-infused desserts; a surprise carving battle puts the teams to the test before judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller make their decision.

foodnetwork.us.title: Halloween Wars - Back from the Dead: Final Four
foodnetwork.us.description: As the race to the finale heats up, Jonathan Bennett challenges the final four teams to create terrifying toys and elevated treats inspired by childhood favorites; judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller decide which teams earn a pass to the finale.

foodnetwork.us.title: Halloween Wars - Back from the Dead: The Final Fright
foodnetwork.us.description: Jonathan Bennett challenges the final teams to create killer carnival showpieces, interactive games and elevated carnival treats; judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller decide who will be crowned Halloween Wars champion and take home $30,000.

foodnetwork.us.title: Halloween Baking Championship - Engrossed With Ghosts
foodnetwork.us.description: Host John Henson has a close encounter with a ghost that inspires ghostly transformation desserts; one supernatural sweet scares up $1,000 after impressing judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell.

foodnetwork.us.title: Halloween Baking Championship - Messages From Beyond
foodnetwork.us.description: Henson asks the bakers to make cryptic message desserts that reveal an eerie dispatch from the other side. Judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell must decide who wins $1,000 for their mysterious missive and whose message now reads exit.

foodnetwork.us.description: Creativity turns creepy as John Henson asks the bakers to craft a horrifying fusion of two beings into one spliced souls dessert; judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell decide which baker best captures the terror of transformation.

freeform.us.title: Cinderella
freeform.us.description: With a wicked stepmother (Eleanor Audley) and two jealous stepsisters (Rhoda Williams, Lucille Bliss) who keep her enslaved and in rags, Cinderella (Ilene Woods) stands no chance of attending the royal ball. When her fairy godmother (Verna Felton) appears and magically transforms her reality into a dream come true, Cinderella enchants the handsome Prince Charming at the ball, but must face the wrath of her enraged stepmother and sisters when the spell wears off at midnight. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1950

freeform.us.title: Alice in Wonderland
freeform.us.description: Lewis Carroll's beloved fantasy tale is brought to life in this Disney animated classic. When Alice (Kathryn Beaumont), a restless young British girl, falls down a rabbit hole, she enters a magical world. There she encounters an odd assortment of characters, including the grinning Cheshire Cat (Sterling Holloway) and the goofy Mad Hatter (Ed Wynn). When Alice ends up in the court of the tyrannical Queen of Hearts (Verna Felton), she must stay on the ruler's good side -- or risk losing her head. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1951

freeform.us.title: Mulan
freeform.us.description: Fearful that her ailing father will be drafted into the Chinese military, Mulan takes his spot -- though, as a girl living under a patriarchal regime, she is technically unqualified to serve. She cleverly impersonates a man and goes off to train with fellow recruits. Accompanied by her dragon, Mushu, she uses her smarts to help ward off a Hun invasion, falling in love with a dashing captain along the way. (Animated, Children, Musical) - 1998

freeform.us.title: Aladdin

But can Aladdin save Princess Jasmine and his love for her after she sees that he isn't quite what he appears to be? (Animated, Children, Musical comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

freeform.us.title: The Little Mermaid
freeform.us.description: In Disney's beguiling animated romp, rebellious 16-year-old mermaid Ariel (Jodi Benson) is fascinated with life on land. On one of her visits to the surface, which are forbidden by her controlling father, King Triton, she falls for a human prince. Determined to be with her new love, Ariel makes a dangerous deal with the sea witch Ursula (Pat Carroll) to become human for three days. But when plans go awry for the star-crossed lovers, the king must make the ultimate sacrifice for his daughter. (Animated, Children, Fantasy) - 1989

freeform.us.title: The Hunchback of Notre Dame

When the beautiful young woman catches the attention of Quasimodo's guardian, sinister Frollo (Tony Jay), Quasimodo must help to keep her out of his clutches. (Animated, Children, Drama) - 1996

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Cead Mile Failte - A Hundred Thousand Welcomes
golfpass.us.description: Twelve aspiring golf professionals from all over the world and from many different backgrounds arrive in Ireland. The players are divided into mixed-teams where they will not only be competing as a team, but living together as well.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Go Green or Go Home
golfpass.us.description: The competition heats up in Ireland as one team fights to stay together. Personalities clash when poor play by a captain forces their team to go to elimination.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - The Fighting Irish
golfpass.us.description: A competitor's life is threatened by a serious illness as the team fights to stay out of elimination; the teams are driven to the edge.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Nothing Is Done Without Effort
golfpass.us.description: One team's recent success is short-lived as news of their fallen teammate spells potential disaster. A remarkable hole-out decides the fate of one captain, leaving the other staring elimination in the face.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Erin Go Bragh -- Ireland Forever
golfpass.us.description: Poor play by one golfer causes deep and irreparable divides within the house. A surprising decision by a captain leaves their team and fate on the brink of elimination.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Emerald Isle Road Trip
golfpass.us.description: The competitors take a road trip to one of Ireland's premiere links courses where the wind and two players' emotions try to blow the teams apart. Distrust and dislike forces one team to put emotions aside for the betterment of the group.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - The Best Ships Are Friendships
golfpass.us.description: Competitors fight to remain and keep their hopes alive. Smelling blood, one team looks to eradicate the opposition.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Gaofar Galfaire - Windy Golfer
golfpass.us.description: With the team competition complete, the final four realize that the end is near, and the title is now within their reach. A long awaited match between former teammates spells disaster for one, leaving the other fighting for their life.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - You'll Need the Luck of the Irish
golfpass.us.description: The final three are only one step away from locking up a spot in the finale, the only question is who will rise to the occasion?

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Pot of Gold
golfpass.us.description: The final two contestants battle it out for the title of champion.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Maiden Voyage
golfpass.us.description: One bad decision could mean elimination on the first day of competition.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Abandon Ship
golfpass.us.description: LPGA player Yani Tseng is the ultimate ringer, and a major twist turns the competition upside down.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Castles Made of Sand
golfpass.us.description: Just three days into the competition, energy and points are running low for some players, and the consequences could be devastating.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Time and Tide Wait for No One
golfpass.us.description: It's a race to win immunity in a challenge where slow play is the ultimate penalty.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Batten Down the Hatches
golfpass.us.description: Another twist in the points race leaves some competitors haunted by past decisions, and surprise guest LPGA player Gerina Piller makes life difficult for those remaining.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Between the Devil and the Deep Blue Sea
golfpass.us.description: With decision-making at a premium, once again, one choice threatens to turn the competition onto an entirely different track.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Marooned
golfpass.us.description: The value of Championship Points becomes even more apparent as one competitor will only get one shot to save herself.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Constant Bearing, Decreasing Range
golfpass.us.description: The 100-point mark is squarely in the sights of one competitor and a bye into the championship seems like a foregone conclusion.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Come Hell or High Water
golfpass.us.description: With the 100-point mark now within reach for all of those remaining, it's now anyone's game to win that elusive bye into the Championship Match.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Daughters of Atlas
golfpass.us.description: Some familiar faces return for revenge, and the last remaining spot in the Championship Match is filled.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - X Marks the Spot
golfpass.us.description: Only one can walk away with the ultimate prize of being crowned the champion of Big Break.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Contact Is King
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick, kicks of The Skill Code with major championship caliber instruction, drills and tips that will be certain to have golfers play better golf.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Curve Control Is Queen
golfpass.us.description: Setup and swing keys that help you curve the ball on command.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Next Level Trajectory
golfpass.us.description: Being able to hit it high and low on command allows players to maintain precise distance control in varied conditions. Whether they're in the wind, under or over trees.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - Battle Plans

(Horror, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2018

mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Two bank robbers (Bruce Willis, Billy Bob Thornton) fall for a bored housewife (Cate Blanchett) who helps them commit heists across the country. - 2001

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Overboard
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Kate is a single, working-class mother of three who's fired by a selfish, spoiled and wealthy Mexican playboy named Leonardo. When Leonardo falls off his yacht and wakes up with amnesia, Kate seeks payback by convincing him that they're married. - 2018

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Fortune Cookie
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A TV cameraman hurt while covering a football game is told by his brother-in-law how to get a big insurance settlement. - 1966

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Bulletproof Monk
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A martial-arts master (Chow Yun-Fat) finds an unlikely protégé (Seann William Scott) to take over the responsibility of protecting an ancient scroll. - 2003

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Downsizing
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A man joins a community of miniaturized people after undergoing a process to shrink himself. As he gets to know his new neighbors and surroundings, he soon learns that living in a tiny suburb comes with its own set of huge problems. - 2017

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Novocaine
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: When the girl of his dreams gets kidnapped, a man turns his inability to feel pain into an unexpected advantage. He fights a bunch of thugs to get her back. - 2025

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Naked Gun

mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Punk rockers, a cremator and medical-supply workers have a problem with zombies in Kentucky. - 1985

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Boo 2! A Madea Halloween
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Madea, Aunt Bam and Hattie journey into the woods to prevent Tiffany from attending a Halloween frat party. Chaos soon strikes when the would-be heroes find themselves fighting for their lives against an array of monsters, goblins and boogeymen. - 2017

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Cold Storage
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors at a former military base. - 2026

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Coyotes
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Members of a family find themselves in a desperate fight for survival when a pack of coyotes swarms their Hollywood Hills home. - 2025

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Once Bitten
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A centuries-old vampire, the countess (Lauren Hutton) has kept her youthful look by drinking the blood of male virgins. Since she finds this prey challenging to come by, she is thrilled when she meets young Mark Kendall (Jim Carrey), who wants to lose his virginity, yet has a reluctant girlfriend, Robin (Karen Kopins). After luring Mark away from a club, the countess drinks his blood, but the hapless guy isn't sure what has happened until he starts exhibiting unusual symptoms. (Comedy) - 1985

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Boo 2! A Madea Halloween
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Tiffany travels to Derrick Lake to celebrate her 18th birthday at a Halloween frat party in the middle of the woods. Frantic and worried, Madea, Aunt Bam and Hattie hop in the car to save her from the same terrible fate that befell a group of teens there years earlier. Chaos soon strikes when the would-be heroes find themselves fighting for their lives against an array of spooky monsters, goblins and boogeymen. (Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 2017

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Men at Work
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Carl Taylor (Charlie Sheen) and James St. James (Emilio Estevez) are garbage men who spend their workdays goofing around and disrupting the quiet on the streets of their town. But their good-natured fun comes to an abrupt halt when they discover a local politician's corpse in one of their cans. Determined that this is their chance to be more than trash collectors, this snarky pair of amateur detectives decide to solve the case on their own and so become entangled in a toxic waste cover-up. (Comedy) - 1990

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: A Night at the Roxbury
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Despite being well into adulthood, brothers Doug and Steve Butabi still live at home and work in the flower shop owned by their dad. They exist only to hit on women at discos, though they're routinely unsuccessful until a chance run-in with Richard Grieco gets them inside the swank Roxbury club. Mistaken for high rollers, they meet their dream women, Vivica and Cambi, and resolve to open a club of their own. (Comedy) - 1998

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Ladies' Man
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Upon losing his lover, Herbert (Jerry Lewis) gives up women for good and seeks a fresh start by taking a maintenance position at what appears to be an ordinary Los Angeles boarding house. To Herbert's surprise, however, the building caters specifically to single women. He immediately resolves to quit, but landlady Miss Wellenmellon (Helen Traubel) and sweet tenant Fay (Pat Stanley) talk him into keeping the job. In no time at all, Herbert is mired in one comic disaster after another. (Comedy) - 1961

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: The Fortune Cookie
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: While taping a football game, cameraman Harry Hinkle (Jack Lemmon) ends up slightly injured after a collision with star player "Boom Boom" Jackson (Ron Rich). When Hinkle's scheming brother-in-law, lawyer Willie Gingrich (Walter Matthau), catches wind of the incident, he wants Hinkle to feign paralysis to scam the insurance company. Hinkle agrees to the plan, if only to win back his ex (Judi West). But Hinkle's growing friendship with a guilt-ridden Jackson has him questioning the ploy. (Comedy drama, Romance) - 1966

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Better Man
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: The true story of the meteoric rise, dramatic fall, and remarkable resurgence of British pop superstar Robbie Williams. (Musical, Biography, Drama) - 2024

mgmplusmarquee.us.description: A centuries-old vampire, the countess (Lauren Hutton) has kept her youthful look by drinking the blood of male virgins. Since she finds this prey challenging to come by, she is thrilled when she meets young Mark Kendall (Jim Carrey), who wants to lose his virginity, yet has a reluctant girlfriend, Robin (Karen Kopins). After luring Mark away from a club, the countess drinks his blood, but the hapless guy isn't sure what has happened until he starts exhibiting unusual symptoms. (Comedy) - 1985

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Coyotes

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Cold Storage
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Two employees at a self-storage company have the wildest shift of their lives when a parasitic fungus that was sealed by the government escapes. As the temperature rises underground, the highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors on the facility's inhabitants -- human and otherwise. (Horror, Science fiction, Comedy) - 2026

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Hart's War
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Lieutenant Tommy Hart (Colin Farrell) is a second year law student who is enlisted as an officer's aide in World War II due to his father's political pull. When he is captured and thrown into a German prisoner of war camp, top ranking Colonel William McNamara (Bruce Willis) assigns him to defend Lieutenant Lincoln Scott (Terrence Howard), a black POW accused of murdering a fellow white prisoner. (War, Drama) - 2002

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Windtalkers
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Marine Joe Enders (Nicolas Cage) is assigned to protect Ben Yahzee (Adam Beach) -- a Navajo code talker, the Marines' new secret weapon. Enders' orders are to protect his code talker, but if Yahzee should fall into enemy hands, he's to protect the code at all costs. Against the backdrop of the horrific Battle of Saipan, when capture is imminent, Enders is forced to make a decision: if he can't protect his fellow Marine, can he bring himself to kill him to protect the code? (War, Historical drama) - 2002

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: U-571
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: When a German U-571 submarine with a sophisticated encryption machine onboard is sunk during a World War II battle at sea, the Allies send an American Navy force led by Lieutenant Andrew Tyler (Matthew McConaughey) to retrieve it for study. Boarding the German ship, the Americans' cover as a rescue force is quickly blown. Forced to take the crew hostage, the Americans lay their explosives and prepare to destroy the German vessel before the Nazis can send naval backup. (Thriller) - 2000

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

mgmplusmarquee.us.title: Platoon
mgmplusmarquee.us.description: Chris Taylor (Charlie Sheen) leaves his university studies to enlist in combat duty in Vietnam in 1967. Once he's on the ground in the middle of battle, his idealism fades. Infighting in his unit between Staff Sergeant Barnes (Tom Berenger), who believes nearby villagers are harboring Viet Cong soldiers, and Sergeant Elias (Willem Dafoe), who has a more sympathetic view of the locals, ends up pitting the soldiers against each other as well as against the enemy. (War, Drama) - 1986

The show also provides tips on how kids can participate in all forms of baseball activities, plus highlights on and off the field throughout MLB. (Baseball) - 2016-04-09

movieplex.us.description: After Nina (Tammy Blanchard) is fired from her waitressing job for being late, she leans on the restaurant's chef, Jose (Eduardo Verástegui), for support. Though they don't know each other very well, Nina confides in Jose that she is pregnant and considering an abortion. Understanding that Nina is going through a tough time, Jose invites her to his home. They spend the day together and tell each other their most painful secrets, and what Nina learns about Jose changes her life forever. (Drama) - 2006

movieplex.us.title: Centurion: The Dancing Stallion
movieplex.us.description: Ellissia adopts a white stallion to train in the art of Mexican horse dancing. As she starts teaching the handsome but previously abused Centurion, Ellissia falls critically ill, which keeps her from competing in a celebrated equestrian event. Under the watchful eyes of her father, new ranch hand Danny steps in as trainer, hoping to win the competition -- and, perhaps, Ellissia's heart. (Drama) - 2023

movieplex.us.title: Jericho
movieplex.us.description: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho. (Western, Mystery) - 2000

movieplex.us.title: McLintock!
movieplex.us.description: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter. (Western, Comedy) - 1963

movies.us.title: Friday the 13th
movies.us.description: Crystal Lake's history of murder doesn't deter counselors from setting up a summer camp in the woodsy area. Superstitious locals warn against it, but the fresh-faced young people -- Jack (Kevin Bacon), Alice (Adrienne King), Bill (Harry Crosby), Marcie (Jeannine Taylor) and Ned (Mark Nelson) -- pay little heed to the old-timers. Then they find themselves stalked by a brutal killer. As they're slashed, shot and stabbed, the counselors struggle to stay alive against a merciless opponent. (Horror) - 1980

movies.us.title: Friday the 13th, Part 2
movies.us.description: The second entry in the long-running horror series focuses on a group of teenage would-be counselors converging on Camp Crystal Lake for training under the tutelage of head counselor Paul (John Furey). Inevitably, Paul relates the story of Jason Voorhees (Warrington Gillette), a boy who ostensibly drowned at the camp and whose mother murdered a group of counselors in revenge. No one takes the tale seriously until a very much alive Jason begins gruesomely eliminating people. (Horror, Action, Mystery, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1981

movies.us.title: Friday the 13th - Part III
movies.us.description: The third installment in the "Friday the 13th" series picks up on the day after the carnage with homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees (Richard Brooker) stealing some clothes and killing a local store owner. Meanwhile, Chris (Dana Kimmell) and her sometimes boyfriend, Rick (Paul Kratka), are hosting a group of teenage friends at Chris' lake house. Despite a run-in with a local biker gang, they enjoy an amiable weekend together -- that is, until Jason begins knocking off kids and bikers alike. (Horror, Action, Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1982

movies.us.title: Friday the 13th: The Final Chapter
movies.us.description: A carefree lakeside vacation is interrupted by the re-emergence of killer Jason Voorhees (Ted White). After he escapes from a morgue, leaving bodies in his wake, Jason travels to Camp Crystal Lake where a group of friends is staying. The teens meet some locals: Tommy (Corey Feldman) and Trish (Kimberly Beck), as well as secretive hiker Rob (Erich Anderson). As the group of teenagers engages in drunken debauchery, their numbers begin to dwindle, and pieces of the past resurface. (Horror, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Thriller) - 1984

movies.us.title: Friday the 13th Part V
movies.us.description: Years after Tommy Jarvis (John Shepherd) murdered hockey-masked serial killer Jason Voorhees, he resides in a mental hospital and struggles with the trauma of the experience. When Tommy moves to an isolated halfway house, he has nightmares about Jason's return, and soon one of the patients (Dominick Brascia) is killed. As the body count grows, Tommy begins to question his sanity and wonder if Jason has risen from the dead. But, to determine the killer's identity, Tommy will need to survive. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery, Action, Drama) - 1985

movies.us.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
movies.us.description: Sam Witwicky and his new girlfriend, Carly, join the fray when the evil Decepticons renew their longstanding war against the Autobots. Optimus Prime believes that resurrecting ancient Transformer Sentinel Prime, once the leader of the Autobots, may lead to victory. That decision, however, has devastating consequences. The war appears to tip in favor of the Decepticons, leading to a climactic battle in Chicago. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2011

movies.us.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction
movies.us.description: After an epic battle, a great city lies in ruins, but the Earth itself is saved. As humanity begins to pick up the pieces, a shadowy group emerges to try to take control of history. Meanwhile, an ancient and powerful new menace sets its sights on Earth. A new group of humans, led by Cade Yeager (Mark Wahlberg), helps Optimus Prime (Peter Cullen) and the Autobots rise up to meet their most fearsome challenge yet: a worldwide war of good versus evil. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2014

nflnetwork.us.title: NFL GameDay Morning ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
nflnetwork.us.description: Rich Eisen leads a cast of NFL talent through four hours of pregame hype, prepping viewers for the kickoffs of Sunday's games. Joining Eisen is Super Bowl champion Kurt Warner, former NFL head coach Steve Mariucci, and special guests each week to break down the matchups. The latest news from around the league, reports from game sites and interviews with players and coaches are featured, and insider Ian Rapoport provides late-breaking news. (Football, News) - 2008-09-07

nflnetwork.us.title: NFL GameDay Live ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
nflnetwork.us.description: Expanding on NFL Network's "GameDay" programming on Sundays during football season, "GameDay Live" updates viewers on what's happening throughout the league. Beginning with kickoff of early-afternoon events and continuing throughout late-afternoon contests, the studio show offers nearly immediate highlights of scoring and other notable plays. But the program is about more than the action; it intersperses highlights of press conferences, interviews with players and coaches, and live reports by announcers at game sites. (Sports talk, Football) - 2014-09-07
