nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore is desperate to land the part of the monster in the school play in 'Clowning Around', then in 'Bully For You', Simon builds a homemade robot bodyguard. (S1, ep 8)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin is sure that Theo has been kidnapped in 'A is for Alien', then in 'Jeanette Enchanted', The Chipmunks and Chipettes join forces to offer Jeanette a magical fairy-tale birthday! (S1, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Dave's amnesia lets the boys skip school for skiing in 'Dave Rebooted', then in 'Germs', ,Theodore fears germs after a school talk. (S3, ep 15)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin notices Brittany being nice to him in 'Brittany the Body Snatcher', and in 'Agent Smith', to earn a job on the school newspaper, Alvin helps Simon uncover the biggest story ever seen. (S2, ep 5)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin must prove that alien life exists in 'Across the Universe', and in 'Britt's Picks', Brittany's furious when she thinks Alvin has been writing on her blog, and vows to get him back? (S3, ep 19)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin regrets pranking Simon after facing payback in 'Curiosity Killed The Alvin', then in 'House Pest', Miss Croner moves in and annoys the chipmunks. (S3, ep 9)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin and Brittany are convinced Simon has vanished back in time in'Time Flies', and in 'Prank Calls', a prank call by Alvin gets out of hand when someone vows to track him down! (S2, ep 26)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Dave struggles on a hike with the Chipettes in 'Girls Night Out', then in 'Tables Turned', Alvin's prank on Simon backfires. (S3, ep 14)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin and Brittany face a spooky mystery in 'School Alone', then in 'It Came From Outer Space', Alvin's fake meteor causes chaos. (S3, ep 13)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon's plant experiment creates a growing monster in 'A Rose By Another Name', then in 'Queen Bee', Brittany admires bees after living as one. (S3, ep 20)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore struggles to do good deeds in 'Knights', and then in 'Snake Charmer', Alvin and Simon create a fake snake to help Dave get over his fear of snakes. (S2, ep 19)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Miss Miller gets robbed in 'The Great Chipmunk Detective', and in 'Guitar Hero', Alvin begrudgingly agrees to teach Miss Smith guitar, but she won't reveal why she needs to learn. (S3, ep 25)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: When Alvin finally pushes Miss Smith too far, she quits in 'Missing Miss Smith', then in 'Monster Madness', Alvin and Simon tease The Chipettes about being scared by a movie. (S2, ep 14)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon creates a Super Hero costume for a convention he's attending in 'Munk Man', and in 'Ride Along', when Alvin's bicycle is stolen, he joins forces with Officer Dangus to solve the case. (S2, ep 7)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The boys accidently break Dave's new flat screen TV in 'The Fugitives', and in 'Sherlock Chipmunk', Jeanette and Eleanor act as Sherlock Holmes and Watson when Theodore's teddy disappears. (S3, ep 10)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin's convinced Dave will abandon him in the desert in 'Deserted', and in 'The Great Snack Off', Alvin and Theodore play a seemingly innocent game, which leads to unexpected consequences. (S5, ep 1)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Eleanor has prepared a cake for a Bake-Off in 'Let Them Eat Crumbs', and in 'Who Ghosts There', worried that Dave will move the family to his dream house, the boys make it seem haunted. (S1, ep 23)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore is desperate to land the part of the monster in the school play in 'Clowning Around', then in 'Bully For You', Simon builds a homemade robot bodyguard. (S1, ep 8)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore is convinced that Miss Croner's missing cat is the cause of a terrible curse in 'Good Luck Mr. Whiskers', then in 'Who's Your Daddy', Dave gets a cold, so Alvin takes over. (S1, ep 10)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin is sure that Theo has been kidnapped in 'A is for Alien', then in 'Jeanette Enchanted', The Chipmunks and Chipettes join forces to offer Jeanette a magical fairy-tale birthday! (S1, ep 2)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: A local haunted house doesn't seem too scary in 'Time Traveller's Party', then in 'Return of Thornbergaupht', Derek bullies Simon by not allowing him to use the boys' bathroom. (S5, ep 9)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore is training for a TV baking competition with Eleanor in 'Allergic Reaction', then in 'Lice-enced to Teach', Dave sets up a classroom in the house, and becomes the teacher. (S4, ep 16)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Eleanor and Jeanette wonder if Brittany would care for them in 'Sick as a Chipmunk', then in 'Instant Gram, Dave makes several embarrassing posts on social media, and Alvin tries to help. (S4, ep 23)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The Chipmunks and Chipettes play in a dodgeball tournament in 'Munk Vs Machine', then in 'Shack Magic', The Chipmunks find a shack that magically fills with toys and games, but is it magic? (S4, ep 9)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin gets a device that let's him listen in on everyone's conversations in 'iHear', and in 'Switch Witch', the Halloween candy disappears and perhaps the culprit is the Switch Witch. (S2, ep 9)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Pirates show up at the house in 'Pirates Life', then in 'World Record', The Chipmunks and Chipettes compete to set a world record in hopes of winning a new virtual reality game. (S4, ep 6)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Simon's experiments cause trouble when Dave asks him to declutter in 'Pack Animal', then in 'The Haunted Getaway', the boys face a haunted cabin. (S3, ep 21)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

screenpix.us.title: The Ape
screenpix.us.description: Dr. Bernard Adrian (Boris Karloff) is researching a way to help a wheelchair-bound patient, Frances (Maris Wrixon), use her legs again. The only way he can achieve this is by procuring spinal fluid from a human. When an ape escapes from a circus, Dr. Adrian kills it in a confrontation and successfully uses its spinal fluid on Frances -- but he needs more. Using the ape's body as a suit, he kills townspeople in a crazed attempt to complete his plan. (Horror) - 1940

screenpix.us.title: Kingdom of the Spiders
screenpix.us.description: Arizona farmer Walter Colby (Woody Strode) and his wife, Birch (Altovise Davis), have a problem on their hands: One of their cows was just killed by a creature, but they have no idea what the beast could have been. So they consult local vet Dr. Robert Hansen (William Shatner), who becomes puzzled and calls in scientist Diane Ashley (Tiffany Bolling). Eventually, the duo discovers that oversize spiders are invading the small town, putting the entire population in danger as a county fair begins. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1977

screenpix.us.title: The Belly of an Architect
screenpix.us.description: Stourley Kracklite (Brian Dennehy), a driven, detail-obsessed architect, travels from America to Rome with his much younger wife, Louisa (Chloe Webb), to oversee an architectural homage to a personal hero, 18th-century master builder Etienne-Louis Boullée. En route by train, Stourley and Louisa conceive a much-wanted child -- but Stourley's obsession with his wife's expanding belly, her perceived infidelity, and his own recurrent bouts of abdominal pain reach epic and dangerous proportions. (Comedy drama) - 1987

screenpix.us.title: The Malta Story
screenpix.us.description: During World War II, British photo-reconnaissance pilot Peter (Alec Guinness) discovers that the Italians are planning a secret invasion of Malta, a strategically important island nation critical to keeping the Allied supply lines open. Though they have few resources left, Peter and his commanding officer, Frank (Jack Hawkins), resolve to fight off the enemy and save the island. At the same time, Peter struggles to keep his relationship with a local girl from falling apart. (War) - 1954

screenpix.us.title: Pocketful of Miracles
screenpix.us.description: Beggar Apple Annie (Bette Davis) learns that her daughter, escorted by an aristocratic suitor, plans to visit. It's great news -- except that she has tricked her daughter into believing she is a wealthy socialite. Fearing her true identity will disappoint, Annie petitions a superstitious mobster (Glenn Ford), who thinks the apples she sells are lucky, for help. Hesitant at first, the mafioso is persuaded by his girlfriend (Hope Lange) to disguise Annie, if only long enough to fool her daughter. (Comedy drama) - 1961

screenpix.us.title: How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying
screenpix.us.description: J. Pierpont Finch is a lowly window cleaner with dreams of making it big in the business world. After finding a copy of the book "How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying," Finch decides to apply the tactics in the book to his own life. Soon, he's working as a mail-room clerk at the World Wide Wicket Company and quickly fighting his way up the corporate ladder with relative ease in this quirky musical based on the hit Broadway production. (Musical comedy) - 1967

screenpix.us.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
screenpix.us.description: Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Doctor Watson (Andre Morell) meet with a certain Dr. Mortimer (Francis De Wolff), who tells them of the legend of the "hound," born out of a murder committed by Sir Hugo Baskerville centuries ago. Explaining that Sir Charles Baskerville recently died in the same location as Sir Hugo, Mortimer expresses his deep concern that Sir Henry, the heir to the Baskerville estate, will also fall prey to the evil hound's curse. Holmes sets out to investigate. (Mystery, Horror) - 1959

screenpix.us.title: Lord of Illusions
screenpix.us.description: Private eye Harry D'Amour travels to Los Angeles and meets with a new client, Dorothea Swann. Swann reveals that she and her husband — famed magician Philip Swann — have been targeted by a religious cult experimenting with reincarnation. After Philip dies on stage in the midst of a dangerous trick, D'Amour must struggle to protect Dorothea from the ruthless cult members and their newly reanimated religious leader, Nix. (Horror) - 1995

screenpix.us.title: Crime of Passion
screenpix.us.description: When newspaper columnist Kathy Ferguson (Barbara Stanwyck) meets cop Bill Doyle (Sterling Hayden), the two quickly hit it off and get married. Kathy gives up her career and heads to Los Angeles with Bill to settle down. The homemaker lifestyle doesn't suit Kathy, however, and she becomes bored with her life and resentful toward Bill because he doesn't share her drive for success. She then secretly decides to make major moves to further Bill's career -- even if it means murdering his rivals. (Crime drama) - 1957

screenpix.us.title: Cloudburst
screenpix.us.description: Canadian World War II veteran John Graham (Robert Preston) works in London as a code breaker. Tragedy strikes when his pregnant wife, Carol (Elizabeth Sellars), is accidentally run over by two crooks who are speeding away from the scene of a murder. Haunted, grieving and thirsting for revenge, Graham sets out to find the two fugitive murderers. When he does, he intends to kill them, the same way they killed Carol. But will that assuage his grief? (Mystery) - 1951

screenpix.us.title: The Woman in the Window
screenpix.us.description: With his family packed off to Maine, Professor Richard Wanley is anticipating some quiet time alone. Then he meets Alice, the model for a portrait he admires, and can't resist her offer of a drink. No sooner do they get to her place, however, than her jealous boyfriend arrives in a rage. Richard kills him in self-defense, and they decide to hide the body. Things go smoothly until Richard's D.A. friend invites him to tag along on the investigation of his own crime. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1944

screenpixaction.us.title: Madhouse
screenpixaction.us.description: The career of horror icon Paul Toombes (Vincent Price) ends in scandal when his fiancée dies under mysterious circumstances. Freed from the mental hospital where he had been committed, the recovered Toombes and screenwriter Herbert Flay (Peter Cushing) intend to revive his most popular character, Dr. Death, for a television series. But the dead bodies start piling up -- all of them killed in ways that mimic the victims in Toombes' films -- and to clear his name he must find the real killer. (Horror) - 1974

screenpixaction.us.title: The Haunted Palace
screenpixaction.us.description: Condemned warlock Joseph Curwen curses a New England village just before being burned alive. More than a century later, Curwen's kindly great-great-grandson Charles Ward (also Price) arrives in town and moves into Curwen's old mansion. Caretaker Simon Orne helps Charles and his wife Ann adjust to their new home. The ancient curse, however, takes hold of Joseph, awakening inside him a long-dormant evil passed on through blood. (Horror) - 1963

screenpixaction.us.title: I Bury the Living
screenpixaction.us.description: Robert Kraft (Richard Boone) inherits a familial post as the chairman of a small-town cemetery. The centerpiece of the cemetery office is a map of all the plots: White pins signify those claimed, black pins those occupied. When Robert accidentally puts a black pin in the just-purchased plots of a friend (Glenn Vernon) and his new wife, they die in a freak accident. Robert's uncle (Howard Smith) convinces him to make another switch, to see if it's coincidence or something more sinister. (Mystery) - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: The Blood on Satan's Claw
screenpixaction.us.description: When a mysterious corpse is accidentally dug up by a boy in a small town, a group of local teens starts acting very strangely. The adolescents, led by a girl named Angel (Linda Hayden), are convinced the corpse was once possessed. Hoping to get in touch with the devil through the body, the teens act out a series of demonic rituals that causes a stir among the townspeople. When word of the satanic activity spreads, certain parents start trying to lock up the kids behind the spooky stunts. (Horror) - 1971

screenpixaction.us.title: Gog
screenpixaction.us.description: A mechanical brain is programmed to sabotage the government's secret lab while working on the first space station. (Science fiction) - 1954

screenpixaction.us.title: Konga
screenpixaction.us.description: A botanist's experiments with primates and plant serum transform a lovable chimpanzee into a giant killer gorilla. (Science fiction, Thriller) - 1961

screenpixaction.us.title: China Doll
screenpixaction.us.description: Pilot Cliff Brandon (Victor Mature) flies missions from China in support of troops in the Pacific Theater, but is depressed by his situation and takes to excessive drinking. After one late-night binge, he finds that a young woman named Shu-Jen (Li Hua Li) has been either sold or betrothed to him. Brandon is reluctant to acknowledge the relationship, but he finds himself increasingly eager to return to Shu-Jen. When she becomes pregnant, his priorities change dramatically. (War) - 1958

screenpixaction.us.title: Johnny Cool
screenpixaction.us.description: A rich divorcee (Jim Backus) joins a Sicilian hit man (Henry Silva) sent to Los Angeles by a deported mobster. (Crime drama) - 1963

screenpixaction.us.title: Tower of London
screenpixaction.us.description: In 15th-century England, Richard III (Vincent Price) desperately wants the throne, but his ailing brother, King Edward IV (Justice Watson), instead bestows it upon his other sibling, Clarence (Richard McCauly). This sends Richard into a homicidal rage, resulting in Clarence's murder and the deaths and torture of many others who could keep the crown from the crazed man. But as the mayhem continues, Richard's sanity slips, and the ghosts of the murdered men begin to haunt the beleaguered royal. (Horror) - 1962

screenpixaction.us.title: The Pit and the Pendulum
screenpixaction.us.description: Elizabeth Barnard Medina (Barbara Steele) has died in the prime of life, and her brother, Francis (John Kerr), wants to know why. Elizabeth's husband, Nicholas (Vincent Price), and her doctor offer differing explanations, but when Francis learns that Nicholas' mother may have been buried alive, he begins to wonder if his sister met the same fate. And when he comes to believe that Elizabeth's spirit wanders about Nicholas' castle, Francis investigates -- and is stunned by what he finds. (Horror) - 1961

screenpixaction.us.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
screenpixaction.us.description: Based on the classic story "The Fall of the House of Usher" by Edgar Allan Poe and directed by legendary filmmaker Roger Corman, this thriller features Vincent Price as Roderick Usher, a man who believes his family to be cursed by incurable madness. So sure is he of his family's doom, that when his sister Madeline (Myrna Fahey) announces her engagement to Philip Winthrop (Mark Damon), Roderick will stop at nothing to prevent their marriage and keep the Usher bloodline from continuing. (Horror) - 1960

screenpixaction.us.description: In a dystopian future, insurance fraud investigator William Geld (Tim Robbins) arrives in Shanghai to investigate a forgery ring for "papelles," futuristic passports that record people's identities and genetics. Geld falls for Maria Gonzalez (Samantha Morton), the woman in charge of the forgeries. After a passionate affair, Geld returns home, having named a coworker as the culprit. But when one of Gonzalez's customers is found dead, Geld is sent back to Shanghai to complete the investigation. (Science fiction, Romance, Thriller, Drama) - 2003

screenpixvoices.us.title: They Call Me Mister Tibbs!
screenpixvoices.us.description: In this sequel to "In The Heat of the Night," Detective Virgil Tibbs (Sidney Poitier) must solve the murder of a prostitute. The last person witnessed with the victim is Tibbs' friend, Logan Sharpe (Martin Landau), a preacher and activist. Despite his loyalty, Tibbs must investigate when Sharpe admits having visited the prostitute. In addition to his police work, Tibbs must also ease tension with his wife (Barbara McNair), who wants him to spend more time with her and their children. (Crime drama) - 1970

screenpixvoices.us.title: Number One With a Bullet
screenpixvoices.us.description: Detectives Barzak and Hazeltine are trying their hardest to bring down a drug ring, but they're meeting with trouble at every turn, which leads the officers to suspect a mole in their midst. When the detectives are dissuaded by their superiors from following a lead about the man behind the whole operation, Barzak and Hazeltine are forced to find the truth on their own without the support of their department. (Crime drama) - 1987

screenpixvoices.us.title: The Limbic Region
screenpixvoices.us.description: In San Francisco in the 1970s, a serial killer calling himself The Scorekeeper sends taunting notes to the police and media after each of his kills. Although the case is long closed, obsessed detective Jon Lucca (Edward James Olmos) still suspects the wrong man was named as the killer. Learning he has only weeks to live, Lucca meets with Lloyd Ward (George Dzundza) -- the man he has long been convinced is the murderer, but never had enough evidence to arrest -- intending to force a confession. skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Smurfs

skycinemafamily.uk.description: Papa and the rest of the Smurfs reunite with their human friends to rescue Smurfette from the clutches of evil wizard Gargamel.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Despite his efforts, Peter can't seem to shake his reputation for mischief among the other rabbits. Once he adventures out of the garden Peter finds himself in a world where mischief is appreciated, but soon his family come to bring him home.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Casper
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A lonely boy-ghost befriends the young daughter of a ghost hunter. A grasping heiress calls in the exorcist to clear out the spooks and gain access to the treasures supposedly hidden in the lonely mansion. Father and daughter discover that Casper is not the only spirit haunting the house and find themselves caught up in an adventure.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Hook
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Karate Kid

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Karate Kid Part II

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Karate Kid

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Jeers for Fears; Tea Tale Heart
teennick.us.description: After agreeing to go to the Royal Woods House of Terror, Lincoln and Clyde have to toughen up and face their fears; Lola discovers that Lucy has an old, fragile doll and decides she must borrow it.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - Tricked!
teennick.us.description: For Halloween, Lincoln and Clyde have scoped out a fancy neighborhood to make their dreams of scoring full-size candy bars a reality; Lucy is putting on a haunted maze and the younger girls scheme to get maximum candy.

teennick.us.title: The Loud House - The Price of Admission; One Flu Over the Loud House
teennick.us.description: Lincoln is unable to sleep after watching a scary movie, so he stays awake all night; when a common cold spreads through the Loud house, Lincoln believes his sisters have turned into zombies.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Up, Up, and Vacay!
teennick.us.description: The Thundermans enter a competition to win a dream vacation, but they can not agree on a destination.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - This Looks Like a Job For
teennick.us.description: Max and Phoebe get jobs at a pizza parlor; Max and Phoebe must work together to save their jobs.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Happy Heroween
teennick.us.description: A Halloween storm occurs outside, but inside Colosso keeps the family spooked by telling three scary stories.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Adventures in Supersitting
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max Thunderman are twins in a family of superheroes; Phoebe strives to use her powers for good, and Max embraces the dark side.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Floral Support
teennick.us.description: Max uses Phoebe to help retrieve his chronicle of evil deeds from the school's confiscation closet, but breaks her trust to pull off his plan.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Kiss Me Nate
teennick.us.description: Max is nervous when his girlfriend auditions for the romantic lead in the school play opposite a cute boy, so he convinces Phoebe to audition for the same role.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Dog Day After-School
teennick.us.description: Billy and Nora seek Phoebe's help to retrieve their mother's tablet after it is confiscated at school.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Not So Fast
teennick.us.description: A new super-fast villain is wreaking havoc in Secret Shores; after Billy's speed accidentally triggers an avalanche, he decides to hang up his cape and retire.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans: Undercover - Save the Date
teennick.us.description: Max bets Phoebe she can't turn off being a superhero and go on a normal date; Chloe helps Phoebe do well on the date, but Max tries to sabotage by crying wolf; suddenly, a real supervillain emerges and puts Max and Chloe in serious danger.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Make It Pop Pop
teennick.us.description: Nana and Pop Pop Thunderman come to visit, but when Phoebe reveals Colosso is living in their house, Pop Pop's no-tolerance attitude toward supervillains leads him to banish Max and his bunny best friend to the Detention Zone.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Can't Hardly Date
teennick.us.description: As Sarah and Gideon's crushes on Max and Phoebe escalate, the twins attempt to solve the problem by setting them up on a date with each other; Max wants to win back Sarah after he discovers her uncle is a rock star.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - The Amazing Rat Race
teennick.us.description: Max turns Billy into the world's fastest rat in order to win the rat races that he has with members of his band.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Mall Time Crooks
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max head out on a trip to the mall to buy Hank's birthday gift and end up having a run-in with security.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Side-Kicking and Screaming
teennick.us.description: Max & Phoebe secretly employ their parents' former sidekick to ease their busy schedule, but the twins' bickering and inability to share provokes an unexpected response from their new sidekick.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Haunted Thundermans
teennick.us.description: The Thundermans travel to New Orleans to help the Hathaways and the Prestons when a super villain escapes Ghost World on Halloween.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Date of Emergency
teennick.us.description: Phoebe fakes a romance after feeling left out with her friends all in relationships, but maintaining the lie proves to be harder than she expected.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Thundersense
teennick.us.description: Phoebe gets the ability to sense danger and uses it to impress her classmates; Max tries to get pity gifts from Barb.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Z's All That
teennick.us.description: Phoebe and Max act as superhero mentors to one of their siblings but quickly regret selecting Nora after seeing Billy's surprisingly impressive skills.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Pretty Little Choirs
teennick.us.description: The twins work together to get even with a mean girl at school.

teennick.us.title: The Thundermans - Beat the Parents
teennick.us.description: When Max feels nervous about meeting his girlfriend's parents, he seeks Phoebe's help to try and win them over.

teennick.us.title: Liar, Liar, Vampire
teennick.us.description: When people start believing a boy (Rahart Adams) is actually a vampire, a school friend (Brec Bassinger) helps him look and act the part. - 2015

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Meat Cute
trutv.us.description: Attention shoppers; the Jokers make mischief by taking unflattering pictures of grocery store patrons, then posing as horrible employees at the Yeti store; tonight's loser must meet his fate in a punishment.

trutv.us.title: The Suicide Squad
trutv.us.description: The government sends the most dangerous supervillains in the world to the remote, enemy-infused island of Corto Maltese. Armed with high-tech weapons, they trek through the dangerous jungle on a search-and-destroy mission with Col. Rick Flag. - 2021

trutv.us.title: Blue Beetle
trutv.us.description: Jaime Reyes finds himself in possession of an ancient relic of alien biotechnology called the Scarab. When the Scarab chooses Jaime to be its symbiotic host, he's bestowed with a suit of armor that's capable of extraordinary and unpredictable powers. - 2023

trutv.us.title: Mortal Kombat
trutv.us.description: Hunted by the fearsome warrior Sub-Zero, MMA fighter Cole Young finds sanctuary at the temple of Lord Raiden. Training with experienced fighters Liu Kang, Kung Lao and the rogue mercenary Kano, Cole prepares to stand with Earth's greatest champions to take on the enemies from Outworld in a high-stakes battle for the universe. (Action, Adventure, Martial arts, Fantasy) - 2021

trutv.us.description: The Jokers mix it up at an after-dark social event, and try getting park-goers to sign up for bizarre subscriptions; the losing Joker gets into an unforgettable battle of the sexes with special guest Kim Fields. (Reality, Comedy) - 2024-02-15

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Eric Andre Returns
trutv.us.description: The Jokers ask random park goers to watch their grandma while they make a quick errand, then a fake documentary interviews them; the losing Joker gets dressed as a clown and punished by the other Jokers and returning special guest, Eric Andre. (Reality, Comedy) - 2024-02-29

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Harvey Guillen

trutv.us.title: Impractical Jokers - Check Yourself

trutv.us.title: Wonder Woman 1984
trutv.us.description: Diana Prince lives quietly among mortals in the vibrant, sleek 1980s -- an era of excess driven by the pursuit of having it all. Though she's come into her full powers, she maintains a low profile by curating ancient artifacts, and only performing heroic acts incognito. But soon, Diana will have to muster all of her strength, wisdom and courage as she finds herself squaring off against Maxwell Lord and the Cheetah, a villainess who possesses superhuman strength and agility. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2020

trutv.us.title: The Batman
trutv.us.description: Batman ventures into Gotham City's underworld when a sadistic killer leaves behind a trail of cryptic clues. As the scale of the perpetrator's plans become clear, he must bring justice to the abuse of power and corruption that plagues the metropolis. (Action, Adventure, Crime drama) - 2022

trutv.us.title: Aquaman
trutv.us.description: Once home to the most advanced civilization on Earth, the city of Atlantis is now an underwater kingdom ruled by the power-hungry King Orm. With a vast army at his disposal, Orm plans to conquer the remaining oceanic people -- and then the surface world. Standing in his way is Aquaman, Orm's half-human, half-Atlantean brother and true heir to the throne. With help from royal counselor Vulko, Aquaman must retrieve the legendary Trident of Atlan and embrace his destiny as protector of the deep. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2018

trutv.us.title: Wonder Woman
trutv.us.description: Before she is Wonder Woman, she is Diana, princess of the Amazons, trained to be an unconquerable warrior. Raised on a sheltered island paradise, Diana meets an American pilot who tells her about the conflict that's raging in the outside world. Convinced that she can stop the threat, Diana leaves her home for the first time. Fighting alongside men in a war to end all wars, she finally discovers her full powers and true destiny. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, War) - 2017

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Phantom of the Paradise
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After record producer Swan (Paul Williams) steals the music of songwriter Winslow Leach (William Finley) and gives it to one of his bands, Leach sneaks into Swan's offices. Catching Leach, Swan frames him for dealing drugs, which lands him in prison. After Leach breaks out and again attempts to sabotage Swan's empire, an accident crushes his face. Leach then dons a costume and becomes the Phantom, intent on ruining Swan while saving singer Phoenix (Jessica Harper) from a terrible fate. (Musical comedy) - 1974

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cat People
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Irena Dubrovna (Simone Simon), a New York City–based fashion designer who hails from Serbia, begins a romance with marine engineer Oliver Reed (Kent Smith). After the couple gets married, Oliver becomes concerned about Irena's notion that she is cursed and may transform into a large cat in the heat of passion. Confiding in his beautiful assistant, Alice Moore (Jane Randolph), about his marital issues, Oliver unwittingly triggers Irena's curse, with tragic results. (Horror) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Seventh Victim
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After young Mary Gibson (Kim Hunter) discovers that her older sister Jacqueline (Jean Brooks) has disappeared, she leaves her boarding school and heads to New York City to track down her sibling. Arriving at Jacqueline's apartment, Mary finds ominous signs of trouble, with her sister nowhere in sight. Aided by psychiatrist Dr. Louis Judd (Tom Conway) and others, Mary gets drawn deeper into the mystery, and evidence begins to point to the involvement of a sinister cult. (Horror) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Leopard Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When Latin dancer Clo-Clo (Margo) begins to overshadow nightclub singer Kiki Walker (Jean Brooks), Kiki's agent, Jerry Manning (Dennis O'Keefe), decides to spice up his client's act with an enormous black leopard on a leash. But the big cat escapes from the club -- and soon after, a young girl (Margaret Landry) and others are found dead around their small town. When evidence suggests that the killer may be human, suspicion falls on the leopard's Native American owner (Abner Biberman). (Horror) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Night of the Living Dead

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Eye of the Devil

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Blithe Spirit
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Skeptical novelist Charles Condomine (Rex Harrison) invites self-proclaimed medium Madame Arcati (Margaret Rutherford) to his home for a séance, hoping to gather material for a new book. When the hapless psychic accidentally summons the spirit of Condomine's late wife, Elvira (Kay Hammond), his home and life are quickly turned into a shambles as his wife's ghost torments both himself and his new bride, Ruth (Constance Cummings). As she gets closer to H. Driffold Cosgood and his fellow performers, yet another actor is found dead. Her digging uncovers evil deeds that date back several years, but Miss Marple finds herself in danger as she closes in on the killer. (Mystery, Crime drama) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Gone With the Wind
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Presented as originally released in 1939. Includes themes and character depictions which may be offensive and problematic to contemporary audiences. Epic Civil War drama focuses on the life of petulant Southern belle Scarlett O'Hara. Starting with her idyllic life on a sprawling plantation, the film traces her survival through the tragic history of the South during the Civil War and Reconstruction, and her tangled love affairs with Ashley Wilkes and Rhett Butler. (Romance, Historical drama, War) - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Strategic Air Command
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Saga of the US Air Force special bomber unit during the Cold War era. A professional baseball player is recalled to military service because of the expert flying skills he acquired during World War II. Although the athlete and his wife are both reluctant to give up civilian life, both come to realize the importance of the defense mission. The film features spectacular aerial footage of big bombers on maneuvers. (Adventure) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Mountain Road
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Maj. Baldwin (James Stewart) is an American officer stationed in China during World War II charged with stopping the advance of the Japanese army and protecting civilians. One of his tasks is destroying infrastructure to stop the progress of enemy troops. Baldwin is put in command of a unit and is taken aback by how primitive China is. He meets widow Sue-Mei Hung (Lisa Lu) who attempts to explain local customs, but she is ultimately put off by his brutal methods. (War, Drama) - 1960

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Garden of Eden
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Toni LeBrun (Corinne Griffith) is beautiful jazz age singer who takes a job in a Paris cabaret, where she is propositioned by Henry von Glessing (Lowell Sherman), a rich patron of the club. When she refuses his advances, she is fired and joins her wardrobe mistress, Rosa (Louise Dresser), in a fancy hotel in Monte Carlo -- where Rosa reveals herself as a down-on-her-luck baroness in disguise. Posing as the daughter of the baroness, Toni pursues romance, with unexpected consequences. (Romantic comedy) - 1928

mavtv.ca.title: SEMA Battle of the Builders - One Man, Every Detail
mavtv.ca.description: BFGoodrich Young Guns winner THOMAS DICKERSON takes craftsmanship to another level with a 1967 Chevrolet C10 built almost entirely by his own hands. From its tailored chassis and hand-fabricated bed to one-off lighting, flush-mounted glass and a fully custom interior, every detail reflects a singular creative vision. (Auto racing) - 2026-10-07

mavtv.ca.title: SEMA Battle of the Builders - Reinventing the Thing
mavtv.ca.description: Ron Jones reimagines the 1973 Volkswagen Thing as a coach-built, Porsche-powered off-road machine; built around a one-off chromoly long-travel chassis, the vehicle combines hand-formed body panels, more than 350 machined components and performance engineering; follow the team's journey to unite art, comfort and all-terrain capability in an original creation worthy of an off-road category victory at the 2025 SEMA Battle of the Builders. (Auto racing) - 2026-10-14

mavtv.ca.title: SEMA Battle of the Builders - Rebuilding an Icon
mavtv.ca.description: A severely deteriorated 1960 Porsche 356B becomes the foundation for an interpretation of an automotive icon; Pete Jackson and his team reshape the car with flowing body contours, balanced design details and a thoughtfully upgraded engine; see how ingenuity, symmetry and in-house craftsmanship preserve the Porsche's character while creating the sport compact/import performance category winner at the 2025 SEMA Battle of the Builders. (Auto racing) - 2026-10-21

mavtv.ca.title: SEMA Battle of the Builders - Going Fenderless
mavtv.ca.description: Troy Trepanier and Rad Rides by Troy showcase "Fenderless," a scratch-built roadster based on a 1936 Ford; the custom vehicle features reengineered proportions for an open-wheel design, with the body, chassis, suspension, machined components, paint and interior all fabricated in-house; the project highlights the construction behind the custom hot rod that holds the 2025 SEMA Battle of the Builders overall title. (Auto racing) - 2026-10-28

moremax.us.title: The Nun II
moremax.us.description: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. - 2023

moremax.us.title: The Watchers
moremax.us.description: A 28-year-old artist gets stranded in an expansive, untouched forest in western Ireland. Finding shelter, she unknowingly becomes trapped alongside three strangers who are stalked by mysterious creatures every night. - 2024

moremax.us.title: Companion
moremax.us.description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire. - 2025

moremax.us.title: Holla
moremax.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. - 2006

moremax.us.title: Hop
moremax.us.description: Reluctant to take over his father's job, the son (Russell Brand) of the Easter Bunny runs away to Los Angeles, where he tricks an unemployed slacker (James Marsden) into taking care of him. - 2011

moremax.us.title: The Biggest Little Farm
moremax.us.description: A couple are followed through their successes and failures as they work to develop a sustainable farm on 200 acres outside of Los Angeles. - 2018

moremax.us.title: The Last Emperor
moremax.us.description: Named Emperor of China at age 3 in 1908, Pu Yi (John Lone) becomes a prisoner of destiny. - 1987

moremax.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
moremax.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. - 2023

moremax.us.title: Open Water
moremax.us.description: Scuba divers (Blanchard Ryan, Daniel Travis) struggle to survive in shark-infested waters after their tour boat accidentally leaves them behind. - 2003

moremax.us.title: The Apparition
moremax.us.description: A paranormal researcher (Tom Felton) must save a couple (Ashley Greene, Sebastian Stan) from a malevolent entity that feeds on fear and torments them no matter where they run. - 2012

moremax.us.title: The Possession
moremax.us.description: Parents (Jeffrey Dean Morgan, Kyra Sedgwick) must work together to save their young daughter (Natasha Calis) from a dybbuk, a malevolent spirit that inhabits and ultimately devours its human host. - 2012

moremax.us.title: Carrie
moremax.us.description: A social misfit (Sissy Spacek) with psychic powers wreaks havoc at her prom to get even with pranksters. - 1976

moremax.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
moremax.us.description: An ancient Celtic ritual drives Dr. Loomis' (Donald Pleasence) patient to sacrifice an entire family in Haddonfield, Ill. - 1995

moremax.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
moremax.us.description: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1998

moremax.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
moremax.us.description: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2002

moremax.us.title: Red Riding Hood
moremax.us.description: Young Valerie (Amanda Seyfried) feels torn between two men. She loves Peter, but her parents intend that she marry wealthy Henry. Valerie and Peter are going to run away together, but her sister is killed by a werewolf before they can put their plan into action. The villagers call on the help of Father Solomon (Gary Oldman), a famous monster hunter who warns that the beast takes human form by day. Then Valerie suspects that the werewolf is someone she loves. (Horror, Thriller, Fantasy, Romance) - 2011

moremax.us.title: The Wolfman
moremax.us.description: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy. (Horror, Thriller, Action) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The East
moremax.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Head Office
moremax.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (Comedy) - 1986

moremax.us.title: Beirut
moremax.us.description: In the 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who is called back into service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death. Meanwhile, a CIA field agent who is working undercover at the American embassy is tasked with keeping Mason alive and ensuring that the mission is a success. (Thriller, Drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: The Dilemma
moremax.us.description: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out. (Comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Friendship
moremax.us.description: A suburban dad falls hard for his new neighbor. (Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
moremax.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (Fantasy, Horror, Comedy) - 2024

moremax.us.title: The Perfect Match
moremax.us.description: Charlie (Terrence J) is a charming playboy who doesn't believe in serious relationships. His best friends bet him that if he commits to one woman for one month, he's bound to fall in love. Charlie accepts the seemingly easy challenge, but wasn't expecting to cross paths with the beautiful and mysterious Eva (Cassie Ventura). When Charlie coaxes her into a casual affair, Eva turns the tables on him, forcing the lifelong bachelor to question whether he wants more than just a one-night stand. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

moremax.us.title: Lady Bird
moremax.us.description: A teenager (Saoirse Ronan) navigates a loving but turbulent relationship with her strong-willed mother (Laurie Metcalf) over the course of an eventful and poignant senior year of high school. (Comedy drama) - 2017

moremax.us.title: Atomic Blonde
moremax.us.description: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies. (Action, Thriller, LGBTQ) - 2017

moremax.us.title: The Meg
moremax.us.description: Previously thought to be extinct, a massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific. With time running out, a visionary oceanographer recruits rescue diver Jonas Taylor to save the crew and the sea itself from an unimaginable threat a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark known as the Megalodon. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Paula McIntyre's Hamely Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E4 Episode 4 Paula cooks up a healthy version of a sausage roll with carrot ketchup on the side. She meets a Highland dance teacher and her father then shows them how to make the perfect barbecue lamb kebabs.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Frugal Foodie
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E10 Slow Cooker Cooking Let the slow cooker do the work with Steph's Pulled Chicken Tortillas, Slow cooked BBQ Beef and her scrumptious Lemon Self Saucing Pudding.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Lund, Sweden In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year-old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E3 Denise Andrews Macale: Bush Turkey Stew & Chilli Fresh Water Mussels In White Wine Denise Andrews Macale, with the help of Mitch and Ali, turns the humble bush turkey into a delicious stew using basic vegetables and Asian sauces to complement the gamey taste of this native bird.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E12 Cooking With Grapes Raise a toast to the glorious grape as Simon and Maggie celebrate with the fruit of the vine.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E26 Episode 26 Laura makes her delicious Spinach and Feta Rolls in the heart of the Prahran Market. In the Yarra Valley, Charlie Carrington cooks Chicken Enchiladas.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E26 Pesto 2.0 Rachael is known for her delicious and flavourful pesto sauces of all varieties. She prepares a Pesto alla Trapanese, a Sicilian dish made with almonds and tomatoes.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mystery Lane
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E26 The Cause Clever tells Bro and McFlare that she has gathered enough clues to know where the Evil Knight, the most wanted criminal in the animal kingdom, plans to hold the upcoming meeting of his secret organisation, The Cause.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E13 Hot Potatodon Ginger's baby Broccolisaurus friend kicks their ball into Potatodon territory. Now they have challenge the Potatodons to a game to win it back.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E11 Dive Quest The cadets buddy up for their first underwater orienteering adventure, ticking off sea creatures in an epic game of ocean bingo along the way.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: HexVets And Magic Pets
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E22 Ears To You Clarion's troubles help Annette find a solution for him and a patient.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mojo Swoptops
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E10 Dot Pursuit Mojo and Bo can't let Dot see her birthday present early, but Dot can't be stopped!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E16 Andy and the Green Sea Turtles Andy blasts off in his safari sub, heading to Borneo in search of green sea turtles to find out which fish clean their beautiful shells. Along the way, he meets some other animals which have ingenious ways of keeping clean.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E11 Marvellous Maths: 1 Eddie joins Emma and Matt in the lab to sort some socks and learn about classification. Eddie also helps Matt make a delicious Greek salad by following a pattern and using a clever step by step algorithm recipe!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S16 E1 Come to Pontypandy When filming a tourism advert about Pontypandy, Sarah gets carried away with her filming. When she climbs a mountain to get the perfect shot, she ends up stranded on a ledge.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zip And The Tiny Sprouts ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E36 A Million Hums Hum splits himself into dozens of little Hums so he can play with all his friends at once! But can many tiny Hums be as good a friend as one big Hum?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Woohoos!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 The Moon Chomper The Woohoos see the moon apparently disappearing and think something is eating it! They work out that sometimes a big shadow moves over the moon so it looks like it disappears then reappears.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Guess How Much I Love You
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E28 Moon Dance The Winter snow is softening in the meadow and Big Nutbrown Hare finds some beautiful flowers peeking through the snow, a sure sign that Spring is finally on its way.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miffy and friends ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E68 Miffy's best friend's birthday It's Melanie's birthday, and Miffy wants to throw her the best birthday party she's ever had! She invites all their friends.but in her enthusiasm to get the party ready, she forgets to invite Melanie!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Sound Collector
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E32 Float Your Boat When the Sound Collector takes his boat on the stream, its hard to keep on playing!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E35 Winkles Redecorates Winkles has just finished building the preschool for the baby chicks. Unfortunately, there's nothing inside. Winkles realizes that a mechanic shop for preschoolers may not be right. But what is?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BeddyByes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E37 Tutu MeMo and BaBa play dress up. BaBa is sad when a pretty tutu doesn't fit, but fits MeMo perfectly. MeMo sees that BaBa is sad and finds a way for them to both play with the tutu.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mini Kids
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E7 Today Fantus meets an elk, squirrels and an owl.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E46 Chickenrat It's bedtime and Bingo can't remember where she left her beloved Floppy! Retracing their steps, Bingo and Bluey lead Mum through their bizzare day in the hope of tracking her down.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E16 Rope Fizzy and Suds tie themselves in knots exploring the strength of rope through factories, high-ropes courses, and First Nations weaving traditions, ending with a hula-hoop craft.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E10 Marvellous Mangroves Costa and the kids explore a huge mangrove forest that was brought back from the brink of destruction. Now it's teeming with life. Sure, it's a bit smelly, but mangroves are mang-nificent!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E13 If You're Happy And You Know It It's a very happy day in Wiggle Town, John and Lachy are in the Wiggly Kitchen and find a flower with yellow petals, what flower could it be? Smile and sing along it's time for 'If Your Happy and You Know It'.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Great Expo-Tations The Iron Friends must save the pier — then stop Ultron from turning Stark Expo into Ultron Expo!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mecha Builders
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E41 The Escaping Cows Of Sunny Field Farm Cows keep leaving the farm. It's up to the Mechas to solve the mystery of how they keep disappearing.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S24 E12 Thomas & Friends: The Super Engine Thomas helps Ruth fix up an old windmill into her new, energy-efficient workshop.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E26 The Doll Hospital When Peppa gets Teddy dirty jumping in muddy puddles, she goes to The Doll Hospital.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E27 Wendy Wolf's Birthday Wendy Wolf's birthday is here and she has invited Peppa and friends around for a party.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kiri and Lou
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E22 Super Sniffer Lou's trunk has a mind of its own and goes out sniffing while Lou is asleep.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E3 Dinner Time Ginger joins the baby Pea-Rexes on their expedition to find dinner and ends up eating something too hot to handle which alerts the Bananaraptors!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E31 Redbeard the Elf Pirate Barnaby Elf's uncle, Redbeard the Elf Pirate, comes to visit the Little Kingdom, but he has lost his treasure. Holly, Ben, the Fairies, and the Elves must help Redbeard follow the clues to track down the treasure.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E22 Stakeout Strange happenings in the kitchen inspire Flower and Flour to sneak downstairs for a late-night stakeout, only to stumble upon a secret that could lead to the best birthday surprise ever!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E4 Super Helpers Bitsy cheers on Pickles as he learns something new.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E49 Santiago and Bonnie to the Rescue After getting stranded at the bottom of a crevice, Bonnie and Santiago must team up to save the day.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks: Power Heroes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E36 Gloop In The Moat Octobella's moat get gloopes with surprising and unpleasant consequences.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E22 The Octonauts and the Loggerhead Sea Turtle After an undersea tremor separates the Gup-X and its crew, Barnacles seeks guidance from a mysterious sea turtle.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E17 The Castle Badge The squirrels hear an echo-ey voice coming from the top of a castle's spooky tower. Who is making all that noise?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E11 Dive Quest The cadets buddy up for their first underwater orienteering adventure, ticking off sea creatures in an epic game of ocean bingo along the way.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S14 E11 Let's Go Fly a Kite Peter fixes Joe's giant kite and gets it off the ground but the kite is so strong, it pulls James up into the air!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 Nikhil and Jay and the Nana Night Amma and Appa are going out so Nana is babysitting - it's Nana Night! But will the boys get to sleep before they turn into grouchy, sleepy monsters?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E74 I Can Count to Twenty The Numberblobs challenge Twenty to a singing count-off.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Monster Makes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E11 Special Day What makes today in the attic so special? Perhaps the yoghurt pot bee, snappy mouthed plate animals and a cardboard box cake will provide the clues.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey Puppets
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E1 Make Your Own Browny Bear Cool, mysterious - It's Browny Bear. Get on the case and make your own Mr Browny Bear puppet.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E21 The Bubble Dump Mittens and Pants pour bubble mix into the town fountain, accidentally flooding the whole town with bubbles.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E10 Going Wild: 5 Join Teo and Rachael as they cycle through the African savannah and meet all the different craft animals along the way. Through the Windows we venture to Africa and see the wildlife!

BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E6 The Invisible Enemy: Part 2 As the Doctor's condition worsens, he instructs Leela to pilot the TARDIS to the Bi-Al Foundation. The only chance of curing the Doctor is to literally get inside his head.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E7 The Invisible Enemy: Part 3 The Doctor and Leela have been cloned and miniaturised and injected into the Doctor's body. There they must fight the virus on a microscopic level before time runs out.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E8 The Invisible Enemy: Part 4 The Nucleus has escaped the Doctor's body and grown to human size. Its plans to spawn and infect the whole galaxy are nearing fruition. And it looks like K-9 has a new master….

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E9 Image of the Fendahl: Part 1 The Doctor and Leela arrive in present day England at Fetch Priory where a mysterious skull that is older than mankind is exerting a deadly influence on those around it.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E10 Image of the Fendahl: Part 2 As Thea succumbs to the power of the skull, the Doctor realises that an ancient horror from the mythology of his own people is manifesting at Fetch Priory.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E11 Image of the Fendahl: Part 3 Stahl intends to control the power of the Fendahl for himself. The Doctor and Leela take a trip in the TARDIS to discover the truth about the ancient evil from the dawn of time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E12 Image of the Fendahl: Part 4 Thea has become the Fendahl Core and Stahl realises that he is out of his depth as his followers transform into the hideous, snake-like Fendahleen.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S10 E20 Planet of the Daleks: Episode 6 A force of ten thousand Daleks is coming to life below the surface of Spiridon. The Doctor and the Thals must find a way to defeat the Daleks before they invade the galaxy.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E14 The Sun Makers: Part 2 The Doctor is taken prisoner by the Gatherer and sent to the Correction Centre. Leela mounts a rescue attempt, but the Gatherer’s men are waiting.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E15 The Sun Makers: Part 3 The Doctor is free but Leela has been captured by the Gatherer and is sentenced to a grisly death by public steaming.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E16 The Sun Makers: Part 4 The Others launch a full-scale uprising against the Gatherer and his Inner Retinue while the Doctor confronts the real head of the Company.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E17 Underworld: Part 1 The TARDIS lands on a spaceship which is crewed by the survivors of the planet Minyos who are on a quest to find the lost ship, the P7E. Their journey has taken them 100,000 years.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E18 Underworld: Part 2 When their ship crashes beneath the surface of a newly formed planet, the Minyan survivors discover what they have been searching for. But their arrival is not welcomed.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E19 Underworld: Part 3 The Doctor and Leela attempt to penetrate the Citadel of the Seers to rescue Idas’s father who has been sentenced to death.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E20 Underworld: Part 4 The Minyans are eager to recover the race banks that they have waited so long to find, but the Doctor becomes suspicious when the Oracle simply allows Jackson to take them.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E21 The Invasion of Time: Part 1 Leela is concerned by the Doctor’s strange behaviour when, after a secret meeting with aliens, he returns to Gallifrey and abruptly stakes his claim on the Time Lord presidency.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E22 The Invasion of Time: Part 2 The Doctor is made president of the Time Lords and immediately orders K9 to lower the planet’s defences and has Leela banished to the wilderness.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E23 The Invasion of Time: Part 3 The Doctor has betrayed his own people and enabled a Vardan invasion of Gallifrey. Leela joins forces with the Outsiders and prepares to strike back against the aliens.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E24 The Invasion of Time: Part 4 As the Vardans finally fully materialise on Gallifrey, the Doctor prepares to spring his trap. But does a more deadly alien force lie behind the Vardans?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E25 The Invasion of Time: Part 5 The Sontarans have taken control of the Capital on Gallifrey and intend to use the power of the Time Lords to rampage through all of time.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S15 E26 The Invasion of Time: Part 6 Stor, the Sontaran leader, finally gains access to the TARDIS in search of the Great Key of Rassilon and a dangerous game of hide and seek begins inside the Doctor’s ship.

Now Bill Lanier (Jack Hedley) wants to dig up a burial ground for development purposes, and Morgan Whitlock (Lon Chaney Jr.) tries to stop him. Soon, unexplainable accidents start to happen to members of the Lanier family, throwing suspicion on Morgan. The real truth Bill discovers is much more sinister than he expected. (Horror) - 1964

fxm.us.title: Bigger Than Life

Ed agrees to an experimental treatment with cortisone, and makes what appears to be a miraculous recovery. However, upon his return home, his wife, Lou (Barbara Rush), notices severe mood shifts in him. His friend and coworker Wally (Walter Matthau) also perceives the changes, and discovers that Ed has been abusing the cortisone. (Drama) - 1956

fxm.us.title: The Lieutenant Wore Skirts
fxm.us.description: Successful scribe and decorated veteran Gregory Whitcomb (Tom Ewell) is ordered to reenlist in the U.S. military, so his spouse Katy (Sheree North), a former participant in the Women's Army Corps, resumes her old post to be closer to him. Unfortunately, Gregory's been sitting behind a desk since World War II ended, and he soon learns he's too out of shape to serve. Now, as Katy searches for a loophole that will free her from the Army, Gregory haplessly tries to take her place on the home front. (Comedy) - 1956

fxm.us.title: How to Steal a Million
fxm.us.description: Charles Bonnet (Hugh Griffith) expresses his passion for art by forging masterpieces -- and selling them at a hefty profit. The trouble starts when his reproduction of a prized sculpture winds up in a famous Paris museum. If experts determine that it is inauthentic, Bonnet's reputation will be tarnished. That's why his fetching daughter, Nicole (Audrey Hepburn), hires cat burglar Simon Dermott (Peter O'Toole) to steal the sculpture back before it's too late. (Comedy) - 1966

fxm.us.title: Two for the Road
fxm.us.description: Architect Mark Wallace and his wife, Joanna, travel to France to meet with an affluent client. While there, they reflect on their first decade of marriage -- memories of when they first met, of courtship and of road trips through the French countryside. As flirtation and playful quarreling turn to boredom with the banality of married life, the Wallaces struggle to rekindle their passion, while mutual infidelity threatens to tear them apart. (Romantic comedy) - 1967

fxm.us.title: The Book of Life
fxm.us.description: In the Mexican town of San Angel, Manolo (Diego Luna), Maria (Zoë Saldana) and Joaquin (Channing Tatum) have been friends ever since childhood. Although their lives have taken different paths -- Maria was sent to Europe, Joaquin joined the military, and Manolo studied to become a bullfighter -- one thing remains the same: Manolo and Joaquin both want to marry Maria. Little does the trio know that battling husband-and-wife deities have made a high-stakes wager on the love triangle's outcome. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2014
