bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Perigord Rick Stein arrives in the region of Perigord, famous for decadent dishes; he discovers his favorite market in the city of Perigueux and learns about the region's historical relationship with England as the former kingdom of Aquitaine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Roussillon Rick Stein's journey of discovery brings him to the sunnier climes of the Mediterranean, where he explores the French-Catalan legacy of Roussillon on the foothills of the Pyrenees next to the Spanish border.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Secret France
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Languedoc Rick Stein approaches the end of his meander through France with a final glance at the culinary delights of the Languedoc before crossing over to Provence and the Mediterranean coastline that reveals new insights into southern French cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Rick's journey begins in the magnificent city of Venice and on the idyllic Greek island of Symi he cooks some of his favorite Venetian dishes: seafood risotto, tiramisu and gnocchi with spider crab.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Rick Stein continues his gastronomic journey from Venice to Istanbul; in the Byzantine city of Ravenna he discovers Piadinas, street food dating back to Roman times.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Rick Stein continues his Byzantine odyssey through Croatia and savours the famous native oysters of Ston; he then crosses the border to Albania, a country loved by Lord Byron.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Rick Stein's gastronomic journey from Venice to Istanbul brings him to Northern Greece and the historic city of Ioannina where he tastes a traditional Veal Stifado and Kotopita.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rick Stein arrives in the Greek Peloponnese and samples memorable dishes like rooster stew hilopites with mizithra cheese and the best home-made moussaka he's ever had; in his Symi island kitchen, he cooks galaktoboureko.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Turkey Rick Stein's journey from Venice to Istanbul is nearing its completion as he leaves southern Greece for the shores of Western Turkey.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Rick Stein's culinary odyssey ends in the legendary city of Istanbul where he enjoys a fishing expedition on the Bosphorus and cooks lavish kofte kebabs with pistachios.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Spain
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Rick tours Spain on a journey of discovery and culinary delight; Rick begins his tour in Galicia on the Atlantic coast, driving an old camper van suitable for venturing to places off the beaten track.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Spain
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 From Basque Country To The Mediterranean Rick travels eastwards towards the Mediterranean, sampling dishes along the way.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Spain
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Castile Rick sets out for El Cid in his rusty but trusty camper van, exploring the land's classic castles and plains; he heads for La Mancha, the heart of Spain famous for rustic food and wine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Spain
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Extremadura and Seville Rick visits the little known region of Extremadura, famous for its pimentón and Spain's most celebrated ham, Ibérico; he drives south to Spain's most romantic city and the home of tapas and flamenco, Seville.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Fruits of the Sea
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Rick cooks seafood paella, spicy Thai fish curry, and scallops.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Fruits of the Sea
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Fish tagine, monkfish tacos and some tangy Thai fishcakes.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Fruits of the Sea
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Squid in red wine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Fruits of the Sea
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 A dish of crabmeat, wine and garlic.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Fruits of the Sea
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Rick Stein uses the humble whelk to make a mouth-watering dish and prepares one of the sea's treasures -- bass.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Fruits of the Sea
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 For Mayday, Rick cooks a fish pasta, talks about oysters and cooks baked Cod Portuguese; Rick goes out fishing with two friends and makes crab pasties for them.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Fruits of the Sea
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 A special dish for the Royal Navy of ragout with turbot and scallops.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Fruits of the Sea
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E08 Rick travels to Australia, a country he first visited 30 years ago; in Sydney, Rick prepares spicy laksa, barbecued fish and seared tuna.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Corsica and Sardinia Rick Stein discovers sausages and sheep's cheese and explores the locals' passion for chestnuts in Corsica.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 On a misty lagoon in Sardinia Rick watches the fishermen catch mullet using the same methods as the Romans did centuries before. He boards a ferry for Sicily to find, in the heart of Palermo, one of the best pasta dishes he's ever tasted.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 Sicily and Puglia Rick travels from Sicily to Puglia.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Corfu Rick departs Italy and makes his way to the Greek island of Corfu, where he attends a family feast; he visits kitchens in restaurants all over the island and learns how to make dishes such as a Greek peasant salad with feta and olives and more.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mallorca and Catalonia In Mallorca, Rick finds wonderful seafood dishes and the most succulent roast lamb he's ever tasted, while in Barcelona he samples Catalonian food at the famous Boqueria market.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Morocco and Turkey Rick samples the delights of couscous, tagines and mint tea in Moroccan bazaars, before heading along the old silk route to south-eastern Turkey, where he tastes the finest kebabs.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E01 Shellfish Chef Blanc celebrates the best of British shellfish as he cooks dishes including Moules Marinière, seared squid salad and Scottish lobster.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E02 Cakes and Pastries Chef Raymond begins with a feather-light lemon tea cake, coated in an apricot jam and tangy lemon glaze; he also makes a choux pastry filled with chocolate cream and covered with a chocolate icing; lastly, the secrets to the perfect macarons.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E03 Lamb Chef Blanc shares his favorite lamb dishes: lamb liver with caramelized potatoes and French seasoning, a slow-roasted garlic and herb lamb shoulder with potato and turnip gratin and lamb Provencal with ratatouille.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E04 Pudding Raymond celebrates his passion for puddings, cooking dishes including riz au lait, tarte tatin and fruit crumble.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E05 Charcuterie Chef Raymond shares his love of charcuterie, beginning with thin slices of duck cured in herbs and juniper berries; also, he makes a chicken liver parfait and a meaty pot-au-feu medley; lastly, a ham hock terrine served with home-made pickles.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E06 Spices and Chillies Drawing upon his travels through Asia, Raymond creates dishes full of fragrant spice and fiery heat.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E07 Summer Fruits Raymond demonstrates the versatility of the summer's juiciest fruits with a simple but impressive berry-strewn pavlova and a spicy cherry clafoutis where the vibrant fruit is cushioned in a bed of soft, sumptuous pastry.

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets
bbcfood.us.description: S02 E08 Summer Greens Raymond celebrates the freshest summer greens, beginning with a simple yet vibrant pistou soup, laden with summer vegetables and bursting with basil, topped with crispy croutons and meltingly rich Parmesan.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 San Francisco to Monterey Rick enjoys sitting on the dock of the bay in San Francisco, tasting legendary dishes like the hangtown fry; San Francisco is also the home of sourdough and where America's love affair with seasonal cooking took hold.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E02 Monterey to San Diego Rick Stein continues traveling down the Californian coastline immortalized by Steinbeck.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E03 San Diego to Baja California Rick enjoys a hearty steak and eggs American diner special and bids a fond farewell to his trusty Ford Mustang as he heads across what is reputed to be the busiest border crossing in the world.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E04 Guadalajara to Puerto Vallarta Rick lands in the town that gave the world tequila and the metropolis that birthed mariachis and dishes like chili con carne.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E05 Mexico City to Oaxaca Rick Stein visits the Mexican capital to sample the Aztec cuisine.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E06 Oaxaca to Chinantlan Mountains Rick Stein's latest travels take him to Mexico's culinary capital Oaxaca.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Road to Mexico
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E07 Oaxaca to Yucatan Peninsula Rick Stein heads east from Oaxaca to the Yucatán Peninsula, a place once frequented by real pirates of the Caribbean, including Sir Francis Drake.

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein's Mediterranean Escapes
bbcfood.us.description: S01 E01 Corsica and Sardinia Rick Stein discovers sausages and sheep's cheese and explores the locals' passion for chestnuts in Corsica.

buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

cinevault.us.title: Mortal Thoughts
cinevault.us.description: A loathsome man ends up dead, but it's not clear who's to blame. If ever a person got what he deserved, it's James Urbanski (Bruce Willis), an abusive drunk who steals from his wife, Joyce (Glenne Headly), and promises her close friend Cynthia Kellogg (Demi Moore) that she'll be the next target of his rage. At a group outing, James bleeds to death after someone cuts his throat. But because he's such a terrible human being, police aren't sure which of his acquaintances decided to kill him. (Drama, Movie) - 1991-04-19

cinevault.us.title: The Deep
cinevault.us.description: Undersea adventure about a couple who become involved in a dangerous conflict with treasure hunters when they discover a deadly shipwreck in Bermudan waters. (Adventure, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 1977-06-17

cinevault.us.title: The Fog
cinevault.us.description: The prosperous town of Antonio Bay, Ore., is born in blood, as the town's founders get their money by murdering a colony of lepers. But the truth of what they did is concealed from subsequent generations. More than 100 years later, Elizabeth Williams (Maggie Grace), whose family lives in Antonio Bay, returns just as a statue in tribute to the founders is to be unveiled. When a mysterious fog rolls in, Elizabeth and her boyfriend (Tom Welling) soon discover it has vengeful supernatural powers. (Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2005-10-14

cinevault.us.title: The Cave

Thinking that memories of life as a superspy are just the ticket, Quaid undergoes the procedure -- but it goes horribly wrong. Suddenly, Quaid is a hunted man. He teams up with a rebel fighter on a search to find the head of the underground resistance and take down the leader of the free world. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Mystery, Science fiction) - 2012-08-02

cinevault.us.title: The Stepfather

He becomes increasingly suspicious of the man and wonders if the pleasant exterior hides a sinister side. (Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2009-10-16

(Movie, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2017-09-29

cinevault.us.title: The Exorcism of Emily Rose

Moore is prosecuted for the wrongful death of a girl thought to be demonically possessed, because he administered the church-sanctioned exorcism that ultimately killed her. Prosecuting attorney Ethan Thomas contends that the young woman, Emily, suffered from schizophrenia and should have been medically diagnosed. Meanwhile, defense lawyer Erin Bruner argues that Emily's condition cannot be explained by science alone. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2005-09-09

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Fangs of Death
electricnow.us.description: Flynn leads the others on a rescue mission, which leads them into a subterranean trap filled with ancient Egyptian werewolves.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Reunion of Evil
electricnow.us.description: A routine artifact retrieval becomes complicated when the artifact grafts itself to Cassandra; a blizzard forces Stone and Cassandra to take shelter at a mysterious hotel.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Self-Fulfilling Prophecy
electricnow.us.description: After seeing a vision of her own death at the hands of a supernatural assassin, Baird attempts to stop the deadly prophecy from coming true.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Tears of a Clown
electricnow.us.description: The librarians investigate a traveling carnival where they discover the sinister secret of a magician who has been corrupted by the use of real magic.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Trial of the Triangle
electricnow.us.description: In order to stop the spread of pure evil, the team must find the Eye of Ra and unravel the mystery of the Bermuda Triangle; Flynn must pass a series of tests.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Curse of Cindy
electricnow.us.description: Cindy Kroger suddenly becomes popular thanks to a magical love potion; the librarians must stop Cindy before she launches a love missile that would force the entire world to become her fan base.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Eternal Question
electricnow.us.description: The librarians are led to a holistic spa that is run by vampires when a rash of people spontaneously combust.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Fatal Separation
electricnow.us.description: The balance of the universe is put in jeopardy when the Monkey King's sacred homeland of Shangri-La is taken over by a ruthless collector of magical artifacts.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Wrath of Chaos
electricnow.us.description: The library is simultaneously infiltrated by DOSA and Apep; Flynn, Baird, Stone, Cassandra, Ezekiel and Jenkins must put aside their differences to save the library, the world and themselves.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarian: Curse of the Judas Chalice
electricnow.us.description: Unlikely adventurer Flynn Carsen sets out to protect a precious chalice from vampire Prince Vlad Dracul. - 2008

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Dark Secret
electricnow.us.description: A secret sect of the Vatican Church unearths a map detailing the locations of the four cornerstones of the Library of Alexandria; Flynn and the Librarians work with an unexpected ally to stop them before the stones can be used to destroy the Library.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Steal of Fortune
electricnow.us.description: When people begin getting hurt in the unluckiest of ways, the Librarians follow the trail to a casino where the owner appears to possess an artifact capable of stealing people's luck.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Christmas Thief
electricnow.us.description: Santa takes Flynn, Baird and Jenkins on his first vacation in centuries; the Librarians use Santa's sleigh to save Ezekiel's career-criminal mother, as well as Christmas itself, from Santa's grinch of a brother, the Patron Saint of Thieves.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Silver Screen
electricnow.us.description: Drawn into the world of Baird's favorite film noir movie, the Librarians must perfect their skills in lassoing, sharpshooting and snappy dialogue to make it out alive.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Bleeding Crown
electricnow.us.description: Flynn is excited to team up with his Librarian hero, Darrington Dare, to take down an ancient and powerful enemy let loose in the modern day; Darrington leaves the Librarians with a dire warning that there can only be one Librarian.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Grave of Time
electricnow.us.description: When Baird goes after Nicole Noone in an attempt to repair her rift with the Library, she winds up joining Nicole on a mission to retrieve a dangerous artifact before it falls into the hands of Russian grave robbers.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Disenchanted Forest
electricnow.us.description: When dissension threatens the group, Baird takes the Librarians to a charismatic self-help guru's team-building camp on the edge of a forest where people have been mysteriously disappearing.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Hidden Sanctuary
electricnow.us.description: Cassandra decides to take a vacation after she freezes up during a mission; during her visit to Havenport, labeled the "Safest Town in America," Cassandra believes things may not be as ideal as they seem.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And a Town Called Feud
electricnow.us.description: When a town's Civil War re-enactment is plagued by ghosts, the Librarians have to uncover the truth of what really happened there over 100 years ago.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And Some Dude Named Jeff
electricnow.us.description: After switching bodies with a 28-year-old slacker named Jeff, Jenkins enlists the help of Jeff's hapless friends to find his way back into the Library to correct the mistake.

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Trial of the One
electricnow.us.description: It's time to choose the Librarian who will be tethered to Baird, but no one can decide, so the Library comes up with a trial during which the Librarians will be reduced to their most primal selves and abandoned in nightmarish landscapes. (Drama, Adventure) - 2018-01-31

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Echoes of Memory
electricnow.us.description: The world is morphed into an unrecognizable place where the library never existed; Baird brings the librarians together in an attempt to prevent the bleak, new world from becoming the new reality. (Drama, Adventure) - 2018-02-07

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians - And the Crown of King Arthur

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter - And the Con-Con
electricnow.us.description: Connor is forced to reconnect with people from his pre-Library life, and must defeat an old adversary who has grown powerful in his absence. (Drama, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2025-06-30

electricnow.us.title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter - And the Hangover From Hell
electricnow.us.description: After a bachelorette party with Lysa's childhood best friend, the team wakes up in rough shape and hungover, with no idea how they ended up where they are. (Drama, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2025-07-07

fifthgear.us.description: S06 E01 It's the ultimate showdown, a quarter mile drag between a Formula One car, a superbike and a racing powerboat to find out which is quickest.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S06 E02 Tiff Needell tests the latest car to join the elite ranks of road cars capable of over 200mph including such mouthwatering prospects as the Enzo Ferrari, the Pagani Zonda, and the Porsche Carrera GT.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S06 E03 Fifth Gear will be testing three of the most economical cars on the market.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S06 E04 Tiff Needell and Vicki Butler-Henderson report on Fifth Gear's fastest ever crash test crashing a Smart into a concrete block; Jason Plato drives through five countries in 24 hours.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S06 E05 Vicki Butler-Henderson and Tiff Needell drive some of the best cars made in Britain today.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S06 E06 Vicki Butler-Henderson attempts to drive flat out in Aston Martin's new Vanquish S; the 520bhp, £175,000-plus super-coupe accelerates from 0-60 in 4.8 seconds and is capable of over 200mph.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S06 E08 Tiff Needell is joined by Le Mans winner Guy Smith and former rally co-driver Tony Mason to do something that's not as ridiculous as it might sound - caravan racing.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S06 E08 Tiff Needell is joined by Le Mans winner Guy Smith and former rally co-driver Tony Mason to do something that's not as ridiculous as it might sound - caravan racing.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E01 Tiff heads to Anglesey to see what's quickest: a Smart Brabus or Mini Cooper S when they get pitched head to head in the Fifth Gear shoot-out.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E02 Jason Plato is given his toughest mission yet - to do one month's motoring in 24 hours; a bid to give the new BMW 3 Series the ultimate road test.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E03 Tiff heads to Anglesey for two shootouts; the Porsche Cayenne goes head-to-head with the BMW X5; the Renault Clio takes on the Honda Civic.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E09 Jon Bentley is on a mission to discover Britain's Most Prestigious Car.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E05 Tiff Needell races the new Range Rover Sport against a thoroughbred horse; Vicki Butler-Henderson tries out Lamborghini's new automatic with her mother, Valerie Butler-Henderson, at the wheel.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E06 Tom Ford test-drives the Ariel Atom which has no doors, no windscreen, and no bodywork, but it accelerates faster than the McLaren F1.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E07 Tiff Needell teams up with supermodel Jodie Kidd to race a Maserati at the Monza grand prix circuit in Italy; Jason Plato visits the Top Marques Monaco Motor Show.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S07 E08 Tiff tests the BMW M5 by driving from the UK to the famous Pau circuit in France; Tom tests the Ariel Atom.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E01 Tiff Needell test drives the new Aston Martin V8 Vantage, billed as the most desirable sports car in the world; Jon Bentley reveals definitively whether expensive petrol is worth the extra cash.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E02 Jason Plato gets a world's first test drive in the £380,000 Pagani Zonda F; Vicki Butler-Henderson heads to our Anglesey test track to race a Porsche 911 against the Lotus Exige.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Vicki Butler-Henderson is finding out if progress has been made by Mitsubishi, as she races a classic Evo 6 against the very latest Evo 9.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E04 Vicki Butler-Henderson welcomes Michael Schumacher to the show, for his only British television appearance this year.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E05 Tiff tests the grand tourer's handling through the dramatic scenery of Snowdonia in Wales; Jason Plato tests the brand new £115,000 Aston Martin DB9 Volante.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E06 Vicki Butler-Henderson tries to crack 150 mph as she makes an attempt on the Blindfolded Land Speed World Record; can Vicki hold her nerve and set a new record for driving in a straight line?

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E07 Vicki Butler-Henderson jets off to Portugal to drive the new Mazda MX5.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E08 In a superb world first, Tiff Needell gets to drive a Williams Formula 1 Grand Prix car; with exclusive access to the team, follow Tiff every step of the way.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E09 Tiff Needell drives the first Porsche Cayman in the UK along the A537, known as the Cat and Fiddle Road; he evaluates whether the notoriously dangerous route can be navigated safely and enjoyably.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E07 Vicki Butler-Henderson jets off to Portugal to drive the new Mazda MX5.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: Tom Ford puts the Bentley Continental Flying Spur to the test; we take the fastest four-door saloon in the world on a tour of Britain and see just how many swanky events Tom can visit in 24 hours.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S08 E04 Vicki Butler-Henderson welcomes Michael Schumacher to the show, for his only British television appearance this year.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: The big names of the automotive world go under the hood to discuss reviews, news and bargains of the industry.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E01 Jason Plato helps a lottery winner choose a new supercar; Tiff Needell road tests the new Jaguar XK on the best road in the world; Tom Ford meets Jenson Button at the Geneva Motor Show.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E02 A crash test between a Land Rover Discovery and a Renault Espace evaluates safety differences between four-by-four vehicles and multipurpose vehicles.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E03 Vicki Butler-Henderson is the only British journalist invited to test drive Ferrari's new race car, the F430 Challenge; Tom Ford takes an exclusive one-off look into the secret world of the Maybach.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E04 A look at America's most glamorous car club, based in an underground bunker; Tiff and Jason race the BMW M3 against the Audi RS4.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E05 We reveal the Best Cheap Car in Britain, meet the man who's giving away a free Ferrari to try and help sell his house, and a look round the country's ultimate supercar collection.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E06 Jason Plato teaches Girls Aloud how to become racing drivers; Tiff Needell drives the new Maserati Quattroporte, and Tom Ford tries to break the world record for doing donuts in a car.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E07 Vicki Butler-Henderson learns how to become a spy photographer as she goes undercover trying to snap car manufacturer's secret prototypes; Tom Ford is in Japan driving the car of the future.

fifthgear.us.title: Fifth Gear
fifthgear.us.description: S09 E08 Vicki Butler-Henderson finds out exactly how well built a Mercedes is when she crashes it, drowns it in a flood and then drives over it in a monster truck.

filmriseaction.us.description: When a criminal is released from prison, he promptly returns to a life of crime with his lawbreaking brother. - 1998

filmriseaction.us.description: A former thief (Nicolas Cage) has just 12 hours to come up with $10 million after his former partner (Josh Lucas) kidnaps his daughter and locks her in a cab. - 2012

filmriseaction.us.title: Agent Red
filmriseaction.us.description: A Marine commander (Dolph Lundgren) accompanies a submarine carrying a chemical virus to a secure storage facility. - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: Direct Contact
filmriseaction.us.description: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given the chance for freedom if he is able to rescue a kidnapped American woman. - 2009

filmriseaction.us.title: The 51st State
filmriseaction.us.description: A chemist (Samuel L. Jackson) who produces illegal drugs travels to Liverpool, England, to negotiate one last deal before he retires. - 2001

filmriseaction.us.title: JCVD
filmriseaction.us.description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery. - 2008

filmriseaction.us.title: The Contract
filmriseaction.us.description: A man (John Cusack) and his young son (Jamie Anderson) encounter an assassin (Morgan Freeman) while hiking in a forest. - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Operator
filmriseaction.us.description: When the daughter of a dispatcher and a cop is kidnapped, they are forced to follow the kidnapper's rules and have to choose to save their daughter or the city. - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: The Gunman
filmriseaction.us.description: A former Special Forces soldier (Sean Penn) who has PTSD tries to reconnect with his longtime lover, but must first find out who wants him dead... and why. - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmriseaction.us.description: A soldier of fortune (Steven Seagal) seeks revenge after staging a daring jailbreak and being double-crossed. - 2006

filmriseaction.us.title: Freejack
filmriseaction.us.description: Bounty hunters from the future transport a doomed race car driver to New York City in 2009, where his mind will be replaced with that of a dead billionaire. - 1992

filmriseaction.us.title: Eye See You
filmriseaction.us.description: While staying at a clinic for therapy, an FBI agent (Sylvester Stallone) searches for a serial killer who is murdering the staff and patients. - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
filmriseaction.us.description: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it. (Action) - 1976

filmriseaction.us.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
filmriseaction.us.description: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: Castle Falls
filmriseaction.us.description: After decades of neglect, Castle Heights Hospital is packed with dynamite and ready to be demolished. However, no one knows that a gang leader, now in prison, hid $3 million in stolen cash inside the abandoned building. Now, three desperate parties want the money -- and they have exactly 90 minutes to find it and get out alive. (Action, Thriller) - 2021

filmriseaction.us.title: American Yakuza
filmriseaction.us.description: An undercover FBI agent has risen through the ranks of the Yakuza and now finds himself caught in a war between the Yakuza, the mob and the FBI. (Crime drama) - 1993

filmriseaction.us.title: Code Name Banshee
filmriseaction.us.description: Caleb, a former government assassin in hiding, resurfaces when his protégé, the equally deadly killer known as Banshee, discovers a bounty has been placed on Caleb's head. Now, they must put the past behind them and join together one last time to fight off the secret CIA-backed killers who threaten to destroy them. (Action, Drama) - 2022

filmriseaction.us.title: Derailed
filmriseaction.us.description: Secret agent Kristoff (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is assigned to escort Galina Konstantin (Laura Elena Harring), a thief in possession of a deadly virus, on a train journey that unluckily falls on his birthday. Kristoff tells his disappointed wife, son and daughter that he's taking a business trip. They decide to sneak aboard the train as a surprise, only to suspect he's having an affair with the mysterious Galina. To make matters much worse, terrorists hijack the train and go after the virus. (Action, Thriller) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.title: In Hell
filmriseaction.us.description: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity. (Action) - 2003

filmriseaction.us.title: Survivor
filmriseaction.us.description: Framed for a terrorist bombing, a foreign service officer (Milla Jovovich) must dodge a top assassin (Pierce Brosnan), while racing against time to thwart a deadly plot. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

filmriseaction.us.title: Gunfight at Rio Bravo
filmriseaction.us.description: A mysterious Russian gunslinger aids a marshal and a sheriff in a standoff with an outlaw gang who have invaded their town. (Western) - 2023

filmriseaction.us.title: Cover-Up
filmriseaction.us.description: An American journalist (Dolph Lundgren) gets too close to the truth about alleged terrorist attacks in Tel Aviv. (Action) - 1991

filmriseaction.us.title: Blitz
filmriseaction.us.description: A tough cop (Jason Statham) goes after a serial killer who targets police officers. (Thriller, Crime drama, Action) - 2011

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S06 E03 The Tameness of a Wolf Ruth has a mystery admirer who unnerves her; Louisa gets in trouble with Bert when one of her students writes about getting food poisoning at his restaurant.

filmrisebritishtv.us.description: S06 E04 Nobody Likes Me Martin takes baby James to playgroup, where he is forced to sing along with the other moms; Al signs up for a dating website; Bert finds Jennifer in the bathroom with a needle.

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Mercenary for Justice
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag. (Family, Action, Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Heathers
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty). (Dark comedy, Crime drama) - 1989

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Homeboy
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby. (Drama) - 1988

Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond. (Horror, Thriller) - 1980

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Gunman
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. filmrisefreemovies.us.title: 10th and Wolf

lifetimerealwomen.us.title: Rateescape: Stop Overpaying for Cellular
lifetimerealwomen.us.description: Cut up to half the cost of your monthly cell phone bill; same towers, same coverage, but a lot less money; it sounds great but is it too good to be true?; join myth-busting legend Kari Byron as she takes on Big Wireless to save you money. (Consumer)

lifetimerealwomen.us.title: David Jeremiah
lifetimerealwomen.us.description: In this weekly program, Dr. David Jeremiah delivers practical messages to the congregation at the Shadow Mountain Community Church in San Diego. Also featured is music from the Shadow Mountain Community Church Choir and Orchestra, as well as performances by musical guests that have included Steve Green and Charles Billingsley. Men and women who have been impacted by the Turning Point ministry also share their stories with viewers. During the month of December, "Turning Point" usually features special Christmas programming. (Religious) - 2000-04-02

lifetimerealwomen.us.title: Joel Osteen
lifetimerealwomen.us.description: Author and evangelist Joel Osteen spreads his message of love and hope as he preaches at the 30,000-plus member Lakewood Church in Houston. The program can be seen in more than 100 countries. Osteen urges people to live at their full potential and form a close relationship with God. (Religious) - 1999-10-03

lifetimerealwomen.us.title: Dance Moms - May I Have This Dance?
lifetimerealwomen.us.description: Abby makes an announcement; Mackenzie and Asia compete for a featured part in a televised performance; the mothers are furious that Maddie has been promoted to assistant choreographer; Nia struggles to keep up with Asia in a duet. (Reality, Dance) - 2013-04-16

lifetimerealwomen.us.title: Dance Moms - The View From the Top
lifetimerealwomen.us.description: Abby is invited to co-host "The View"; the girls perform their national winning group dance; Cathy and Vivi hold open auditions for the Candy Apples team. (Reality, Dance) - 2013-04-23

lifetimerealwomen.us.title: Married at First Sight - Back to Reality
lifetimerealwomen.us.description: Weddings and honeymoons are in the rearview mirror, and the challenges of day-to-day life set in; Dave and Amber bicker over household tasks; Tristian struggles to trust Mia. (Reality) - 2018-08-21

lifetimerealwomen.us.title: Married at First Sight - Fantasies and Firsts
lifetimerealwomen.us.description: To forge closer bonds with one another, the couples indulge their partners' intimate fantasies and desires; Amber's insecurities fuel doubts about Dave. (Reality) - 2018-08-28

lifetimerealwomen.us.title: Married at First Sight - From Stranger to Sweetheart
lifetimerealwomen.us.description: Halfway through the experiment and the couples are celebrating their one-month anniversaries; they take the opportunity to reflect on their time together so far. (Reality) - 2018-09-04

lifetimerealwomen.us.title: Married at First Sight - State of the Union
lifetimerealwomen.us.description: Dr. Pepper checks in with the three couples; one couple may finally reach a breaking point over dog duty; Dave and Amber's struggles continue. (Reality) - 2018-09-11

lifetimerealwomen.us.title: Married at First Sight - The Art of Communication
lifetimerealwomen.us.description: With just three weeks until decision day, the couples are forced to take a hard look at their own behavior; relationships are tested in ways that could either bring each couple closer together, or push them over the edge. (Reality) - 2018-09-18

logo.us.title: Mama's Family - Mama With the Golden Arm
logo.us.description: Mama emerges as a contender in an arm-wrestling competition and goes up against a biker's equally tough mother.

logo.us.title: RuPaul's Drag Race - Alone Together
logo.us.description: The 12 queens come together in a virtual slumber party; Ru checks in with all the girls during quarantine and chats about the shadiest moments and most shocking eliminations, and takes fan questions.

logo.us.description: The top three queens compete in a revolutionary lip sync battle for the crown; the finale boasts special celebrity appearances, the announcement of Miss Congeniality, and show-stopping performances.

logo.us.title: RuPaul's Drag Race - RuCo's Empire
logo.us.description: The queens get their Cookie on in two Empire-inspired scenes; guest judges Tasha Smith and singer-songwriter Faith Evans.

logo.us.description: Naomi feels neglected when Vint decides to join an elite men's club.

logo.us.description: Mama helps Aunt Effie recover from a concussion.

logo.us.title: Mama's Family - Educating Mama
logo.us.description: Bubba learns he has to attend night school to graduate high school; when it is revealed that Mama doesn't have her high school diploma, she joins him, but she is soon faced with the same problem she was some 40 years ago.

logo.us.title: Mama's Family - Zirconias Are a Girl's Best Friend

logo.us.description: Iola and Mama set out to prove that Vint isn't Raytown's serial burglar.

logo.us.description: Mama and Naomi team up for tag-team wrestling.

logo.us.description: Jack signs up for a computer dating service.

logo.us.title: Three's Company - The Best of Three's Company - Part 2

logo.us.description: A newspaper article implies the trio's living arrangement is more than a practical one. (Sitcom) - 1982-10-26

logo.us.description: Chaos results when Jack romances a Mexican girl. (Sitcom) - 1982-11-23

logo.us.description: Jack dates one of Janet's friends from high school, unaware that she is married. (Sitcom) - 1982-11-30

logo.us.title: RuPaul's Drag Race - Supermodel Snatch Game
logo.us.description: The queens impersonate celebrities in a quick-witted TV game show, and dress in iconic Madonna looks for the runway; supermodel guest judges Gigi Hadid and Chanel Iman. (Competition reality) - 2016-04-04

logo.us.title: RuPaul's Drag Race - Wizards of Drag

logo.us.title: RuPaul's Drag Race - Shady Politics

logo.us.title: RuPaul's Drag Race - RuPaul Book Ball

logo.us.title: RuPaul's Drag Race - The Realness

logo.us.title: RuPaul's Drag Race - Grand Finale
logo.us.description: Tensions run high as the queens return to discuss the drama of the season; both America's Next Drag Superstar and Miss Congeniality are crowned. (Competition reality) - 2016-05-16

showtimewest.us.title: Se7en
showtimewest.us.description: A meticulous detective and the young officer about to replace the veteran probe serial murders based on the seven deadly sins.

showtimewest.us.title: Piranha
showtimewest.us.description: Spring break turns gory at a popular waterside resort, where hundreds of prehistoric man-eating fish have come to dine on hapless humans.

showtimewest.us.title: Noah
showtimewest.us.description: God chooses Noah (Russell Crowe) to build an ark and save the animals and his family from an apocalyptic flood.

showtimewest.us.title: The Aviator
showtimewest.us.description: During the 1930s and '40s, wealthy industrialist Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) gains fame as a movie producer, airplane designer and pilot.

showtimewest.us.title: Edge of Tomorrow
showtimewest.us.description: A soldier fighting aliens gets to relive the same day over and over again, the day restarting every time he dies.

showtimewest.us.title: Argo
showtimewest.us.description: During the Iran hostage crisis, an extraction specialist (Ben Affleck) in the CIA poses as a Hollywood film producer to rescue six Americans who eluded Iranian militants and found refuge with the Canadian ambassador.

showtimewest.us.title: Forrest Gump
showtimewest.us.description: JFK, LBJ, Vietnam, Watergate and other history unfold through the perspective of an Alabama man (Tom Hanks) with an IQ of 75.

showtimewest.us.title: Troy
showtimewest.us.description: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy.

showtimewest.us.title: Parasite
showtimewest.us.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

showtimewest.us.title: Vicious
showtimewest.us.description: A strange ritual soon unravels into a waking nightmare when a woman receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love.

showtimewest.us.title: It Follows
showtimewest.us.description: Following a strange sexual encounter, a teenager (Maika Monroe) has disturbing visions and the inescapable feeling that someone -- or something -- is stalking her.

showtimewest.us.title: House at the End of the Street
showtimewest.us.description: A divorcee (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter (Jennifer Lawrence) learn that they have moved next door to a house in which a girl killed her parents, then disappeared, leaving a brother (Max Thieriot) as the only survivor.

showtimewest.us.title: Afflicted
showtimewest.us.description: Two friends' tour of Europe takes a dark turn when one of them contracts a mysterious illness. They race to find out what it is and how to cure it before the sickness consumes him completely.

showtimewest.us.title: Argo
showtimewest.us.description: During the Iran hostage crisis, an extraction specialist (Ben Affleck) in the CIA poses as a Hollywood film producer to rescue six Americans who eluded Iranian militants and found refuge with the Canadian ambassador.

showtimewest.us.title: The Equalizer 2
showtimewest.us.description: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him.

showtimewest.us.title: Rock of Ages
showtimewest.us.description: Songs by Def Leppard, Journey, Joan Jett, Bon Jovi and others underscore a rock 'n' roll romance between a small-town girl (Julianne Hough) and a city boy (Diego Boneta) who meet on the Sunset Strip while chasing their Hollywood dreams.

showtimewest.us.title: Nine
showtimewest.us.description: An Italian director (Daniel Day-Lewis) endures personal and creative crises as he tries to juggle relationships with his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz) and numerous other women.

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E03 Crisis at Crooked Creek A family-run airline flies emergency supplies to a remote village hit by water pollution; Alaska's biggest cargo airline loads high explosives on a busy runway; Anchorage's elite pilots come to the rescue of a holiday party. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S04E02 Snow Bomb Record-breaking snow in Anchorage could shut down the airport; a novice pilot tests his nerve landing on a frozen lake; USAF aircrews battle the toughest Arctic survival training; a unique aircraft workshop Alaska-proofs a vintage. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S07E04 Live and Let Fly A lone bush pilot races to stock ultra-marathon checkpoints; a heli pilot risks a sling-load at 4,000 feet and comes inches from disaster; a vintage DC-3 plane is a village's only lifeline as a storm closes in. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S24E07 Pitch Battle After Colgan Air 9446 crashes off Cape Cod, investigators must determine what brought down a widely-used commuter aircraft in under three minutes. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S16E10 Deadly Delivery UPS Airlines Flight 1354 clips the tops of trees and crashes into a hillside about one nautical mile short of the runway during final approach to Birmingham-Shuttlesworth International Airport in Alabama. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S07E10 Ghost Plane Investigators try to solve the mystery of a plane whose captain and co-pilot are missing. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S11E07 Caught on Tape The dashcam of a passing car captures stunning footage of the final moments of a Taiwanese commuter aircraft as it banks steeply, clips an elevated highway and nosedives into the river; investigators find no signs of pre-impact malfunction. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S25E11 No Exit Following a catastrophic runway collision at LAX, passengers on USAIR Flight 1493 struggle to escape the burning plane. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation, History)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E35 Made in the USA A cross-country flight across America reveals the nation's most iconic industries, the people behind them and the stories of how they came to be. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E46 Alaska's Fire and Ice The world's largest volcanic island; Iceland's landscapes, forged by fire and ice; a tour over Alaska, the residents it attracts and the wildlife that thrives in these unique surroundings. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E38 Texas The Lone Star's rugged canyons, historic ranches and modern cities. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E06 Vermont Northern state's green forests; red-painted barns and sugar maples. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E48 Wilderness A cross-country flight over icy landscapes in Alaska's Denali, vast wetlands in Florida's Everglades, and over 100 million acres of badlands, deserts, and mountains. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E75 Outdoor Adventures A cross-country flight over the nation's mountains, beaches and national parks; visiting other sites that attract adventurers and tourists. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E31 Amazing Destinations Natural wonders, manmade marvels, hidden treasures and places of inspiration. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E27 Kansas An aerial tour of Kansas shows a state with varied landscapes, scenic areas and historical conflict sites. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E37 Beyond Hollywood A coast-to-coast aerial journey across America, visiting locations made famous by movies such as Rocky, Citizen Kane, Forrest Gump and others. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E65 The Wild West A journey over America's western landscape featuring "wild" history and stories of colorful characters. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Disasters Engineered
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E01 Manned Missions Trace the chain of events that led to a deadly explosion on the Deepwater Horizon rig and unleashed the largest marine oil spill in history; see the failed part that caused the NASA Challenger Space Shuttle to explode seconds after liftoff. (Episode, Series, Science, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Disasters Engineered
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E02 Chemical Blasts Experts examine how the Chernobyl nuclear disaster and the Bhopal gas tragedy happened; they also explore the consequences and how they could have been avoided. (Episode, Series, Science, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Disasters Engineered
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E04 Industrial Slides A 1966 landslide in Wales killed 116 children and 28 adults; a 2019 dam collapse killed 115 people in Brazil. (Episode, Series, Science, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Disasters Engineered
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E05 Ocean Catastrophes Experts examine what caused the Zeebrugge ferry tragedy and the Costa Concordia cruise ship disaster; what were the consequences, and how could they have been avoided? (Episode, Series, Science, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Disasters Engineered
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E07 Design Failures Experts examine how engineering failures allowed Hurricane Katrina to devastate New Orleans and cause the collapse of the Tacoma Narrows Bridge. (Episode, Series, Science, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Disasters Engineered
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E02 Construction Catastrophe A towering inferno that killed 72 residents becomes Britain's deadliest fire; a pedestrian bridge collapses in Florida over eight lanes of traffic, killing six people; how can fatal design flaws happen in such important constructions? (Episode, Series, Science, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Disasters Engineered
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E04 Beneath the Surface Nothing can stop an earthquake and while the ground may feel solid, below our feet, the earth is shifting constantly, sometimes violently. (Episode, Series, Science, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Disasters Engineered
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E07 Unnatural Causes The 2011 Fukushima nuclear meltdown hit Japan in the wake of a tsunami, creating a crisis on a par with Chernobyl; just a few months later, a lightning strike affected signaling on a bullet train in China, leading to a catastrophic collision. (Episode, Series, Science, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S02E10 Cleared for Disaster An air traffic controller's mistake causes a Boeing 737 to land on a runway already occupied by another aircraft. (Episode, Series, Aviation, Documentary)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Air Disasters

starttv.us.description: Fresh blood stains indicate foul play when Seth (William Windom) disappears; a proliferation of strangers in town raises Jessica's suspicions. (Drama)

starttv.us.title: Murder, She Wrote - Roadkill
starttv.us.description: A Texas trucker (Earl Holliman) is charged with insurance fraud; his son (Patrick Cassidy) is accused of murder. (Drama)

starttv.us.title: Murder, She Wrote - A Murderous Muse
starttv.us.description: Jessica searches for a motive when a legendary maestro, who is about to lose control of his protégé, is found murdered. (Drama)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta
tastemade.us.description: Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils
tastemade.us.description: Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies!

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Not Your Nonna's Risotto
tastemade.us.description: Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits.

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples
tastemade.us.description: Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads!

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals - Comforting Mushroom Soup and Cheesy Soda Bread
tastemade.us.description: Jamie cooks a comforting mushroom soup with cheap air-fryer soda bread for under a fiver, stretches ham hocks into a second teardrop gnocchi meal, makes a low-cost air-fryer chicken burger takeaway clone, and bakes thrifty frozen-berry iced buns!

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Happy Halloween
tastemade.us.description: Boo! It's spooky season, and what better way to get into the spirit than with affordable, party-friendly Halloween dishes that scream trick or treat?! But be warned, these meals are scary good.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Spooktacular Tricks and Treats
tastemade.us.description: Frankie's got tricks and treats up his sleeve this Halloween with simple, wicked good dishes for all to enjoy.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Pantry Pasta
tastemade.us.description: It's no secret that pasta is Frankie's favorite; he's serving it up all night without even opening his fridge.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Salad Salad Salad
tastemade.us.description: Amp up your salad game with a little mixing and matching, from light and leafy greens to crisp and hearty toppings, and dressings for all occasions. Frankie shows us how versatile and fulfilling a homemade salad can truly be.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Meals Under $7
tastemade.us.description: At a loss when your pantry is empty? With these recipes, you can walk into any grocery store with only $7 and walk out with everything you need for an entire meal. Because yes, you can whip up a nutritious meal at an affordable price!

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - How Do You Like Them Apples
tastemade.us.description: Apples aren't just good for keeping the doctor away. Frankie demonstrates how to make the most of this beloved, everyday fruit, from sweet treats to savory meals. There's a whole world of apples to dive into, especially while they're in season.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Bring Your Own Lunch
tastemade.us.description: Frankie is all about BYOL - bring your own lunch. It's not only good for your wallet, it's good for your health. Skip the vending machine and the cafeteria in favor of creative, cost-effective and easy-to-transport midday meals.

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Whole Chicken 101
tastemade.us.description: Join Frankie to learn the ins and outs of using every part of a chicken, as he demonstrates how to maximize the value and minimize waste. By cooking smarter, you'll have three delectable recipes to last you the whole week.
