tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Bison Tomahawk Chop with Italian-style Eggplant and Panzanella
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern shares a simple trick for getting the most out of bison tomahawk chops.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Crispy Duck Noodle Soup
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables
tastemade.us.description: Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
tastemade.us.description: It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Carne Adovada
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Wild Seafood Risotto
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread
tastemade.us.description: Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Holy Mackerel!
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Game Day Chicago-Style Beef Sandwich
tastemade.us.description: Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - A Whole Roasted Hog
tastemade.us.description: For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Most Underrated Game Bird
tastemade.us.description: Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Game Day Fried Squab
tastemade.us.description: Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached. (Cooking) - 2023-09-14

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Wild Boar Playbook
tastemade.us.description: Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home
tastemade.us.description: Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
tastemade.us.description: Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - The Best Fish You're Not Eating
tastemade.us.description: Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
tastemade.us.description: Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade. (Cooking) - 2024-03-12

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Braised Pigeon with Homemade Herb Gnocchi
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening. (Cooking) - 2023-09-11

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Tailgate Surf-and-Turf Po'Boy Sandwiches
tastemade.us.description: Seafood takes center stage as Andrew fries shrimp, squid and small whole fish for Sicilian-style fritto misto, then layers crispy walleye and oysters into a fully dressed po'boy with savory beef gravy. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce
tastemade.us.description: Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew
tastemade.us.description: Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters. (Cooking) - 2023-09-08

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Back to Our Caveman Roots
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Wild Seafood Risotto
tastemade.us.description: Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen - Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread
tastemade.us.description: Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Steakhouse Hero
tastemade.us.description: Susie's bringing in a special guest so you can bring the steakhouse to your backyard! Christie Vanover of Girls Can Grill joins the fun and brings some fingerling potatoes to round out the ribeyes, asparagus, and a one-of-a-kind compound butter! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Santa Maria Tri-tip Hero
tastemade.us.description: If you love outdoor grilling AND flexing your skills by entertaining guests, the next Backyard BBQ Hero is required viewing. Fire up the grill for a show-stopping Santa Maria-style tri tip, a zesty salad, and an unbelievable dinner bread! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Pulled Pork Party Hero
tastemade.us.description: It's always kind of a party in the backyard, but it's really a party when Susie breaks out the smoker for some legendary pulled pork sliders, a homemade coleslaw, and a mac and cheese so creamy even the grownups will rave about it. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Mexican Carne Asada Hero
tastemade.us.description: Grill fatigue is a very real problem, but the globally-inspired menu of carne asada, tomatillo salsa, Mexican street corn, and Tex-Mex beans in this episode of Backyard BBQ Hero is sure to reignite the fire inside and get you outside cooking! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Smoked Brisket Hero
tastemade.us.description: Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Backyard BBQ Hero - Weeknight Family Dinner Hero
tastemade.us.description: Susie from Hey Grill Hey teaches you how to make a full family dinner right in your own backyard in under 30 minutes! When you serve this grilled honey mustard chicken, creamed corn, and mixed veggies, you'll feel like a Weeknight BBQ Hero! (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair
tastemade.us.description: Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
tastemade.us.description: Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need
tastemade.us.description: Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - Every Kind of Rib: Dino, Fried, Smoked, Grilled and Glazed
tastemade.us.description: It's Rib Day on BBQ Smokeout! Noah and Kev are cooking Dino Beef Ribs, Fried St. Louis Pork Ribs, Smoked Pork Spare Ribs with a Hennessey Glaze, and Smoke-Grilled Baby Backs. Plus we're making good old fashioned Dirty Cabbage. (Cooking) - 2026-08-03

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - Beef Shank is the New Brisket
tastemade.us.description: Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor's Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - Louisiana Style Crawfish Boil
tastemade.us.description: It's Crawfish Boil Day on the show. Noah and Kev are making a gigantic Crawfish Boil; plus Smoked King Crab Legs; Grilled Rainbow Trout with Brown Butter and Grilled Lemon; and Kev's famous Red Beans and Rice. (Cooking) - 2026-08-10

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - Why LA's Danger Dog is the Best Thing You'll Ever Eat
tastemade.us.description: Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice
tastemade.us.description: We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens. (Cooking) - 2026-07-27

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out - The Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye
tastemade.us.description: It's Steak Day! We're making a Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye; Steak & Eggs; Carne Asada Tacos with Refried Beans and Charred Tomato Salsa; and a Grilled Pork Chop with a Peach Glaze. (Cooking) - 2026-08-17

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - Catching Gulf Coast Redfish and Blue Crabs
tastemade.us.description: Pat visits Houston to go Gulf Bay fishing with chef Chris Shepherd, hoping to catch some redfish and gather a side of blue crabs. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - West Tennessee Whole Hog
tastemade.us.description: Pat Martin teams up with fellow pitmasters to showcase the rugged and nuanced tradition of whole-hog cooking, West Tennessee-style. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - Uncovering Houston BBQ's Asian Influences
tastemade.us.description: Pat meets the trio behind Blood Bros BBQ to discover how three childhood friends seamlessly blended their Asian-American culture with the Texas barbecue traditions they grew up with. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - Santa Maria Style Sirloin Steak
tastemade.us.description: Pat Martin travels to a picturesque cattle farm in California's Santa Maria Valley, to hear firsthand from a young pitmaster who has uncovered the secrets of real Santa Maria barbecue. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - South Carolina's Coastal Fish Grill
tastemade.us.description: Pat fishes the coastal inlets of Charleston, South Carolina, in search of a delicious sheepshead, which he plans to grill with his friend and chef James London. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - Searching for Oaxaca in Tennessee
tastemade.us.description: Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire - Pit-Cooked Chicken with Alabama White Sauce
tastemade.us.description: Pat Martin travels to Decatur, Alabama to visit a storied institution of barbecue - Big Bob Gibson's. There, he learns the ins, the outs, and the history of a regional delicacy: pit-cooked chicken with Alabama white sauce. (Cooking)

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E09 Organic Lawn Care; Bath Fan Fix Roger visits Harvard University to learn about their new organic lawn-care program and shows Kevin how to make his own compost tea; Tom helps a homeowner prevent mildew in his attic by re-routing a bathroom fan that was improperly vented.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E10 Stone Veneer; Damper Retrofit Installing stone veneer over an ugly concrete retaining wall; What is it?; how to retrofit dampers in forced-air HVAC ducts; Tom shares a viewer tip about how to get the most from a can of insulating foam.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E11 Laminate Countertop; Garden Edging Tom and Kevin build and install new laminate kitchen countertops; Roger helps a homeowner create a clean border between a garden bed and a lawn using steel edging.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E12 Vines; Window Flashing; Noisy Vent Fix Roger helps improve the appearance of an unsightly concrete retaining wall with wooden lattice and climbing vines; What is it?; Tom shows Kevin how to flash a newly-installed window properly; Richard helps a homeowner quiet a noisy PVC plumbing vent.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E13 Water Softener; Deer Damage Plumbing and heating expert Richard Trethewey helps two homeowners repair their broken water softener; Roger helps a homeowner repair and prevent deer damage to one of his evergreen trees; a viewer tip on how to reduce airborne dust while sanding.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E14 Fireplace Surround; Baseboard Heaters Dress up an old fireplace by installing a new mantle and marble hearth; Richard shows Kevin a few ways to improve the appearance of old baseboard heaters.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E15 Bathroom Vanity; Insulation Plumbing and heating expert Richard Trethewey helps a homeowner update the look of her bathroom by installing a new vanity cabinet, countertop, and sink; What Is It?; Tom and Kevin discuss types of wall insulation and how each is installed.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E16 Rainwater Collection; Load-Bearing Wall Roger helps a homeowner conserve water by installing an innovative rainwater collection system; Tom helps a pair of homeowners connect two rooms in their home by removing an interior load-bearing wall.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E17 Ductless Air Conditioner; Mystery Leak Plumbing and heating expert Richard Trethewey heads to Tampa, Fla., to help a homeowner cool off his garage workshop with a ductless air conditioning system; What Is It?; Tom helps a homeowner eliminate a mysterious leak in her living room ceiling.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S08 E18 Foam Crown Molding; Fence Post General contractor Tom Silva helps homeowners in Houston install crown molding in their bedroom using an innovative fastening system; What is it?; Roger and Kevin head outside to replace a rotting cedar fence post.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E10 Newton: Bluestone and a Historic Billiards Room Why Heartbreak Hill is a challenge for runners of the Boston Marathon; prepping the exterior of the house for paint; the progress on the bluestone patio and massive bluestone stairs; spray foam insulation.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E11 Newton: Bringing Light Throughout Wrapping the columns under the back porch in shingles; saving the old plaster in the billiards room using a new adhesive system; selections for the home's lighting, paint colors, and furnishings; rare and valuable antique pool tables.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E12 Newton: Garage Nightmare and Garbage Disposers Rotting problems in the garage; the kitchen is plastered, the new white oak flooring is down, and the cabinets arrive; floor color; a new generation of kitchen garbage disposers; installing a new standing seam copper roof over the back porch.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E13 Newton: Getting The Details Right Kevin talks about fencing; Norm's custom garage doors; Patrick finishes the base molding; Tom is giving a stock door a facelift; Joe is laying the mosaic rug tiles; countertop and tile choices; Roger adds sprinkler heads and drip irrigation.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E14 Newton: In Memory of Joe Ferrante Roger installs sod in the backyard; Kevin meets with Chelsie Arnold to learn more about the quartz and resin countertops being installed in the kitchen; Richard shows Kevin the high-efficiency air conditioning system; new wainscoting for the kitchen.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E15 Newton: Grout, Closets, and a Clawfoot Tub Installing the end grain teak island top for the breakfast area; Richard displays the progress on the second floor bath and strips and refinishes the old clawfoot tub; a custom closet system; using wedges to create even grout lines.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E16 Newton: Winter Wrap Party As the wrap party begins, Kevin, Richard, Norm, Roger and Tom walk through each part of the project: lighting, design, furniture, color schemes, security systems, windows, garage, porch, bathrooms, kitchen and terrace; hanging a historical marker.

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: This Old House
thisoldhouse.us.description: S29 E22 New Orleans: Back on Track At the project house in Holy Cross, progress is being made; at Musicians' Village, Calvin Johnson shows Norm how he is investing sweat equity; trimming the side porch; Kevin meets Mercy Corps program director Rick Denhart.

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

thisoldhouse.us.title: Ask This Old House

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Kayla
tntwest.us.description: When a retired Drug Enforcement Administration agent is shot outside a bakery, the team works to determine if the victim's past cases or current bouncer job are connected to the murder; Nina and Tiffany clash over the use of an informant.

tntwest.us.title: Skyscraper
tntwest.us.description: A security expert must infiltrate a burning skyscraper, 225 stories above ground, when his family is trapped inside by criminals. - 2018

tntwest.us.title: All Elite Wrestling: Collision ᴺᵉʷ
tntwest.us.description: The all new matches, more stories and more action, featuring the world-class All Elite Wrestling roster. (Pro wrestling) - 2026-10-31

tntwest.us.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
tntwest.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (Fantasy, Horror, Comedy) - 2024

tntwest.us.title: The House
tntwest.us.description: Scott and Kate Johansen must figure out a way to earn some money after their daughter's scholarship falls through. When all else fails, the desperate couple join forces with their neighbor Frank to start an underground casino in his home. As the cash rolls in and the good times fly, Scott and Kate soon learn that they may have bitten off more than they can chew. (Comedy) - 2017

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Stay in Your Lane
tntwest.us.description: When a local club owner is found dead, the team works quickly to find the motive behind the murder of a seemingly innocent man; OA is smitten with a new love interest but is concerned that she's mixed up with the wrong crowd. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2024-02-27

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Creating a Monster
tntwest.us.description: When a federal judge is gunned down in broad daylight, the team is sent looking for a suspect with ties to a local Islamic center; Maggie reunites with a former colleague. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2024-03-12

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Sacrifice
tntwest.us.description: When the director of a Brooklyn migrant center is abducted and held hostage along with his wife, the team must work quickly to meet the demands of their kidnapper; Maggie picks Jessica's brain about motherhood. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2024-03-19

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Unforeseen
tntwest.us.description: After multiple people are targeted and killed with a poisonous gas in broad daylight, the team races to find the killer; Maggie continues to explore motherhood. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2024-03-26

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Hero's Journey
tntwest.us.description: The team pivots when their sting operation to secure a massive bomb from an illegal broker leads them to discover that the device is already in the wrong hands; Jubal's promise to be present at his son's birthday party is put to the test. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2022-09-20

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Love Is Blind
tntwest.us.description: When an officer is shot dead at a pawn shop along with the store's owner, the team tries to figure out why a young, recent Ivy League dropout is tied to the crime. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2022-09-27

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Prodigal Son
tntwest.us.description: As the team investigates a deadly robbery, it discovers one of the perpetrators is a classmate of Jubal's son. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2022-10-04

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Victim
tntwest.us.description: The team investigates a series of brutal assaults; OA hides information about his own mugging. (Crime drama, Action, Thriller) - 2022-10-11

tntwest.us.title: FBI - Flopped Cop
tntwest.us.description: When a wealthy accountant is gunned down for secretly testifying against a notorious drug lord, the team's investigation leads Tiffany to ask for help from a friend who was formerly with the NYPD and is related to the dangerous crime boss. tntwest.us.title: FBI - Double Bind

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Murder Comes to Town - Lord of the Rockies
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Nestled in the Rocky Mountains, the peacefulness of Guffey, Colo., is shattered by the savage murders of Carl and JoAnna Dutcher and their 15-year-old grandson, Tony. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Killer Cases - The Exchange Student Murder
truecrimenetwork.us.description: An exchange student finds a career and a love match in the idyllic Missouri university town of Columbia; it's a shock to her friends and family when she disappears, leaving both her child and cellphone behind. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Killer Cases - Murder of the Basketball Star
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Ten days after NBA player Lorenzen Wright goes missing, the player's body is found in a swamp, shot 11 times; police search for clues to identify who killed the basketball star. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: The New Detectives - Deadly Smile
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Investigators and odontologists match bite marks with dental molds taken from suspects. (Reality TV, Science)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: The New Detectives - Military Justice
truecrimenetwork.us.description: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service delves into murder cases within the Navy and Marine Corps. (Reality TV, Science)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Finally Caught - Talley
truecrimenetwork.us.description: When a 77-year-old woman is found murdered in her vandalized house, a wrongfully convicted man is behind bars for 23 years until DNA analysis emerges implicating the real killer. (News)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Finally Caught - Hoffman/O'Brien
truecrimenetwork.us.description: When a popular high school cheerleader is abducted and found stabbed to death in a water retention tank, it takes several years until the murderer makes the mistake of giving the authorities the evidence they needed. (News)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Finally Caught - Hlavka
truecrimenetwork.us.description: When a young woman is found murdered in her apartment, it takes over 40 years to find clues in the cold case; new DNA testing implicates a prominent serial killer as the suspect in the murder. (News)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Targeted for Murder - Misery in Missouri
truecrimenetwork.us.description: After a Midwestern insurance salesman is discovered on the floor of his office with an extra hole in his head, his wife, family, community, and church are drawn into a web of greed, infidelity, and murder. (Regular)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Targeted for Murder - Sex, Lies, and Murder
truecrimenetwork.us.description: When a family woman is gunned down outside her church after choir practice, police uncover a network of corruption and illicit sex lie just below a flawless surface. (Regular)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: I Knew My Murderer - Blood Ties
truecrimenetwork.us.description: When an affluent couple is brutally murdered, a seemingly random home invasion unravels into a sinister plot of greed, deception, and with Kara Lounsbury shockingly close to the family circle. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: I Knew My Murderer - You Ruined My Life
truecrimenetwork.us.description: A love triangle turns lethal-ending in a masked execution that uncovers just how Shawna Nelson will go to eliminate her rival. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: I Knew My Murderer - Theatre Of Blood
truecrimenetwork.us.description: In a jealous rage, 57-year-old professor George Zinkhan murders his wife, her lover and shoots other members of their amateur theater troupe. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: I Knew My Murderer - Amy Bishop
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Neuroscientist Amy Bishop is denied tenor, and it results in deadly consequences for her co-workers. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Heartland Homicide - Nicholas Brophy
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Nicholas Brophy is excited about his senior year, goes out to visit a friend and never returns. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Heartland Homicide - Ivan Radocaj
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Former pro-wrestler Ivan Radocaj, known as the Croatian Giant, is ambushed and brutally murdered in the tiny Manitoba hamlet of Inwood; it looks like a robbery gone wrong, but what investigators hear over a wire tap brings a monstrous plot to light. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: The FBI Files - The Shootist
truecrimenetwork.us.description: The FBI tracks a lone gunman responsible for a string of unsolved bank robberies. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: The FBI Files - Rebellion in Paradise
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Puerto Rican terror group Los Macheteros seeks by violence to end U.S. rule. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: The Devil You Know - Stalking Evil
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Wife discovers her husband is a serial rapist and tries to get proof for the police. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: The Devil You Know - A Serial Killer in the Family
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Woman's own flesh and blood turns out to be a serial killer. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: The Devil You Know - A Twisted Mind
truecrimenetwork.us.description: A woman is shocked to learn her seemingly harmless long-time boyfriend is a serial killer. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: The Devil You Know - Stairway to Hell
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Woman dies in an apparent accident; police believe the truth lies with her husband. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Killer Cases - A Professor's Murder
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Legal scholar Dan Markel is gunned down execution style as he pulls into the driveway of his Florida home. Detectives hunt for a killer, asking themselves who would hire a hitman to murder a law professor. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Killer Cases - Betrayal in Louisville
truecrimenetwork.us.description: A man is gunned down on a Louisville sidewalk; the bodies of two teenage boys are found burned and abandoned in a vacant lot; detectives investigate a connection between the murders. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Meet, Marry, Murder - Taylor
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Angela Taylor hated her estranged husband Bill because he wouldn't grant her a divorce, so she and her lover took matters into their own hands. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Meet, Marry, Murder - Michele Williams
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Greg and Michele Williams were attacked in their home; he died, and she survived; detectives unpick what really happened. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: L.A. Detectives - Hostage; Homicide; Auto Theft; Juvenile
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Deputies confront a distraught man who climbs up a telephone pole carrying an automatic weapon; detectives find the driver's license of a missing man in a skeleton's clothing. (Regular)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: L.A. Detectives - Homicide; Juvenile; Bomb Squad
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Detectives investigate the murder of a man with polio who could paint with his feet; a juvenile investigator probes a child-molestation case. (Regular)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Sunshine Slayings
truecrimenetwork.us.description: Each episode investigates a real murder that took place in an exotic locale, while the victim should have been enjoying the trip of a lifetime. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Sunshine Slayings - Maria & Marina
truecrimenetwork.us.description: When two young women disappear on a backpacking trip through South America, only part of the mystery is solved when strange packages are found near a beach on Ecuador's south shore. (Documentary)

truecrimenetwork.us.title: Forensic Factor: A New Era - Killer Evidence

Featuring countless WWE Hall of Famers and Legends, as well as today's greatest Superstars, this anthology series digs deep into the WWE vault to present hundreds of hours of classic in-ring rivalries and memorable confrontations. Featured Superstars include Roman Reigns, Hulk Hogan, Undertaker, John Cena, Becky Lynch, The New Day, Alexa Bliss, Drew McIntyre, The Rock, "Macho Man" Randy Savage, Charlotte Flair and more. (Show, Sports non-event, Pro wrestling) - 20200327

400000087.title: Duck Dynasty
400000087.description: Jase's hopes to win the inaugural Duck Commander Fishing Tournament is buoyed when he is able to enlist the help of legendary angler Bill Dance. Meanwhile, Willie's vanity over his greying beard leads him to make a questionable decision.

400000087.title: Duck Dynasty
400000087.description: Jase and Jep make a deal with Mia and Merritt to get them to go dove hunting with them. Si tries to make some extra cash by starting a West Monroe tour.

400000087.title: Duck Dynasty
400000087.description: Jumping Asian carp have invaded Monroe's waters so Jase and the guys set out to try to stop them from spreading further. Meanwhile, Willie and Si have to run Willie's Duck Diner for the day.

400000087.title: Duck Dynasty
400000087.description: The family spends a weekend at their childhood summer camp, reliving old memories and working to repair a tennis court Willie built twenty years ago. While at the camp, Jep tries to pass a lifeguard swimming test he failed as a teenager.

400000087.title: Duck Dynasty
400000087.description: Rowdy's adoption is finalized and he officially becomes a Robertson. Jase gets his first massage and enjoys it more than he expected.

400000087.title: Duck Dynasty
400000087.description: After Willie and Jase lose Si's tea cup, Si makes them go to great lengths to find it. When the entertainment for Gus's 1st birthday party falls through, Jep fills in as a magician.

400000087.title: Duck Dynasty
400000087.description: Willie, Korie, Jase and Missy take dance lessons from Sadie to prepare for Reed and Rebecca's upcoming weddings. Jase's plan to perform Reed's wedding ceremony may fall through when he waits until the last minute to renew his ordainment.

400000087.title: Duck Dynasty
400000087.description: When Si decides to retire to pursue a music career, the family organizes a party in his honor. Meanwhile, Willie, Phil and Jase take a road trip to try to recreate an old duck call for Si's retirement gift. (Surprise performance from ZZ Top!)

400000087.title: Duck Dynasty
400000087.description: Phil, Willie and Ms. Kay attempt to produce a cooking video for their fans.

400000087.title: Duck Dynasty
400000087.description: Phil decides to teach his grandkids the value of a hard day's work by building a football field and culminating in a family football game. But Robertson vs. Robertson competition is further sparked.

400000087.title: Duck Dynasty
400000087.description: After a big order comes in Willie pushes the Duck Commander team to meet the tight deadline, so Jase and the warehouse guys come up with a plan to build a conveyer belt.

400000087.title: Duck Dynasty
400000087.description: Brotherly competition gets the best of Willie when he ditches his kids' career day to go play golf with Jase. Stepping in for Willie, Phil and Si show up at the school and become the teachers' worst nightmare.

400000087.title: Duck Dynasty
400000087.description: After blowing up one of Phil's dangerously antiquated duck blinds, the Robertson boys hatch a wild plan to build a luxury duck blind in the sky. Meanwhile, Ms. Kay and the Robertson women hold a yard sale.

400000087.title: Duck Dynasty
400000087.description: Jase feels being COO of Duck Commander entitles him to a new office. But when Willie refuses, Jase hatches a plan to build one anyhow. Willie takes Miss Kay and the grandkids to the petting zoo.

400000087.title: Duck Dynasty
400000087.description: It's duck blind maintenance time again and the boys have discovered the waterline is low. At the levee, they realize this is the work of Phil's bucktoothed arch nemesis...THE BEAVER.

400000087.description: When Willie finds out that his daughter Sadie has a new boyfriend, he wants to get to know him, while instilling some fatherly fear--Robertson style.

400000087.description: Willie decides to expand the Duck Commander brand into the winemaking industry and buys a vineyard...sight unseen.

classica.us.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
classica.us.description: Die Mezzosopranistin Magdalena Kožená und der Tenor Andrew Staples schließen sich Sir Simon Rattle an, um den Zyklus "Das Lied von der Erde" von Gustav Mahler zu Gehör zu bringen. Das Konzert fand am 9. Mai 2021 im Barbican Centre in London statt.

classica.us.title: Debussy, La Mer
classica.us.description: Claude Debussys sinfonische Skizzen für Orchester, allgemein bekannt unter dem Namen "La Mer", beschwören das Meer in seiner vielfältigen Gestalt herauf. Dieses Konzert in der Kölner Philharmonie wird vom Chicago Symphony Orchestra unter der Leitung von Daniel Barenboim gespielt. (Special, Music, Classical, Opera) - 2018-05-11

classica.us.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits
classica.us.description: Der belgische Dirigent Jos van Immerseel leitet Anima Eterna Brugge in einem Konzertprogramm, das dem amerikanischen Komponisten George Gershwin gewidmet ist. Die Aufführung wurde am 3. März 2017 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet.

classica.us.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Halbfinale I: Elias Ackerley
classica.us.description: Elias Ackerley spielt den ersten Satz von Faurés Klavierquartett Nr. 1 mit dem CMIM Ensemble.

classica.us.title: Modena - Stadt von Belcanto
classica.us.description: Die Studenten von Raina Kabaivanska beschäftigen sich mit dem Diptychon von Menotti in Modena.

classica.us.title: Schubert - Vier Impromptus, op. 90 - I
classica.us.description: Roberto Prosseda spielt Mozarts fünfte Klaviersonate und vier Impromptus, Op. 90 von Franz Schubert. Prosseda bringt das Konzert mit einer Interpretation der technisch anspruchsvollen Ballade No. 4, Op. 52 von Chopin zu einem krönenden Abschluss.

classica.us.title: Händel, Der Messias
classica.us.description: Aus dem Theater an der Wien: das Oratorium "Der Messias" von Georg Friedrich Händel (1685-1759) in szenischer Form. Musikalische Leitung: Jean-Christophe Spinosi - Inszenierung: Claus Guth. Mit Susan Gritton, Bejun Mehta, Richard Croft.

classica.us.title: Rina Sala Gallo Piano Competition 2022 - Finalists
classica.us.description: In der Villa Reale di Monza spielen die drei Finalisten des 26. Rina Sala Gallo Klavierwettbewerbs um den Sieg. Das anspruchsvolle Programm bietet Meisterwerke der Klaviermusik von Ludwig van Beethoven, Maurice Ravel und Claude Debussy.

classica.us.title: Wer hat das Boléro von Maurice Ravel gestohlen?
classica.us.description: In der Dokumentation wird der Rechtsstreit um das Musikstück Boléro untersucht. Das Stück wird von Maurice Ravel im Jahr 1928 komponiert und dieser gibt die Rechte an seinen Bruder Edouard. Dieser stirbt 1960 und löst den Rechtsstreit aus.

classica.us.title: Saint-Saëns - Der Karneval der Tiere
classica.us.description: Der mexikanische Dirigent Carlos Miguel Prieto leitet die Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in einer Aufführung der Suite "Der Karneval der Tiere" von Camille Saint-Saëns. Sie besteht aus 14 Sätzen, von denen jeder ein anderes Tier darstellt.

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Streichquartette Nr. 1, 9 & 10
classica.us.description: Das französische Streichquartett Quatuor Ébène feiert den 250. Geburtstag von Ludwig van Beethoven mit der Aufnahme aller sechzehn Streichquartette des Komponisten, aufgeführt in sechs Konzerten in der Philharmonie de Paris im Herbst 2020.

classica.us.title: Brahms Tragische Ouvertüre & Mahler Sinfonie Nr. 1
Orff: Carmina Burana
classica.us.description: Die von Carl Orff komponierten „Carmina Burana" sind in den Jahren 1935 und 1936 entstanden. Die Kantate basiert auf 24 Gedichten aus der gleichnamigen mittelalterlichen Sammlung, bestehend aus zumeist lateinischen Lied- und Dramentexten.

classica.us.title: Europakonzert 2013 aus Prag
classica.us.description: Ralph Vaughan Williams: "Fantasia on a Theme by Thomas Tallis" - Antonín Dvořák: Biblische Lieder op. 99 - Ludwig van Beethoven: Symphonie Nr. 6 F-Dur op. 68 "Pastorale". Magdalena Kožená (Mezzosopran), Berliner Philharmoniker, Leitung: Simon Rattle.

classica.us.title: Ueda -- Someone Out There Is Praying for Peace I
classica.us.description: Andrea Vitello dirigiert die Komposition "Someone Out There is Praying for Peace" der zeitgenössischen Komponistin Rita Ueda. Das Werk ist für Streicher und Tar, ein traditionelles Zupfinstrument der persischen Musik, geschrieben.

classica.us.title: Richard Strauss - Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40
classica.us.description: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchester in einem Konzert mit Richard Strauss' Tondichtung Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Der Violin-Solist ist David Radzynski. Aufgenommen in der Severance Hall in Cleveland im Februar 2023.

classica.us.title: Schostakowitsch - 4. Sinfonie in c-Moll, Op. 43
classica.us.description: Das Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra spielt die Stücke von Dimitri Schostakowitsch nach und verzaubert damit die Zuhörer. Als Dirigent entpuppt sich Yannick Nézet-Séguin, welcher seit knapp zwölf Jahren das Orchester leitet.

But before he faces the blade, he agrees to confess to Father Duffy (Ron Perlman) in the hope that the priest might be merciful enough to spare his life. To extend this family's living space, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into one part cake decorating studio and one part soccer field.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E06 Life-Sized Sister Playhouse Sandra & David's eldest daughter, Harlow, was born with vision challenges and their youngest daughter, Delilah, is just learning to walk. Brian and Sarah build a colorful playland for both children, while also building a decked out BBQ & dining area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Mom's Retreat Melissa and Lee's 3 boys need more room for sports, and Mom needs more peace and quiet! So Brian and Sarah turn the underused backyard into a sports court, a new lounge space, and a luxurious, 3-season Mom's retreat.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 Craft Studio Jenn and Josh don't have enough space in their semi-detached home to enjoy their hobbies. Brian and Sarah build a stylish lounge space and convert the existing garage into a multipurpose space for crafting and playing guitar.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E03 Parisian Escape Paris lovers, Louise and Rick, want to share their European enthusiasm with their two daughters without racking up the mileage. Brian and Sarah build them a French-inspired urban escape. It's Paris in their backyard! C'est magnifique!

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E09 Social Central Sunroom Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 Country Supper Club & Coop Ex-city slickers, Lauren and Mark, miss their friends and family from the city. Brian and Sarah create a country retreat with an outdoor pad, indoor dining lounge, and a chicken coop. When Lauren and Mark's friends visit, they'll never want to leave.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E05 Gentleman's Gym Mom and son duo, Paul and Catharine, are overwhelmed by Paul's multi-level backyard. Paul also finds his current indoor fitness regime frustrating. Brian and Sarah muscle up to the challenge by building a gym in his backyard, alongside a hot tub.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E07 Plunge Pool Paradise Aarati & Dave both work from home, forcing their living room to be a triple duty working/living/children's play area. Brian and Sarah create a flexible structure, install a sleek and sophisticated plunge pool, and create an outdoor fireplace lounge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E12 Communal Gathering Space H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Twins Clubhouse Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E06 Creative Lounge Dave and Jorge love art and entertaining, but with tenants in their basement and no creative space inside, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into a creative party lounge and build a shipping container-inspired structure for an industrial feel.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 His and Hers Hideaway Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E05 Wellness Wonderland Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Farm to Table Andrea and David are foodies, but hosting in their "builder basic" yard is no fun. Brian and Sarah make their farm-to-table dreams come true, with a veggie garden, dining room, BBQ zone, and a play space for their 2 kids.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 Outdoor Amphitheater Jon, Trish, and their two children live in a quintessential family-friendly neighborhood. To give the whole community an outdoor space to enjoy, Brian and Sarah build an outdoor movie theater in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E13 Hillside Playhouse Matt, Mary and their 2 kids don't use their backyard because the neighboring ravine has taken over. Brian and Sarah face environmental challenges to create a beautiful, entertaining and play space for the whole family to enjoy.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E10 Greenhouse Bliss Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Roasting Hilltop Lamb in Basilicata
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Tuscan Farmhouse Classics
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Art of the Egg
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Famous Pastes of Spices
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Mayan Gateway To The Underworld
tastemadetravel.us.description: No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Vietnamese Pizza in Dalat
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Loaded Dogs & Classic Cocktails in San Diego
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie Celenza heads to San Diego to sample a modern spin on classic deli fare, heavily loaded low-riding hot dogs, frosty & fruity Taiwanese snow ice, and fancy French cocktails from a rotating carousel bar.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Pierogies, Bagels, and Ramen in NYC
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie Celenza takes a LOT of bites out of the big apple as he samples warm pillowy bagels & schmear, grabs pierogies at an old school Ukrainian spot, gets the scoop on innovative ice cream flavors, and slurps up some real ramen.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Worth the Hype - Salmon Tacos, Meatballs, & Perogies in Las Vegas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Frankie dazzles in Las Vegas where he enjoys crunchy salmon skin tacos, an homage to after-school snacks, and the dish that put Martha Stewart on the map.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Cooking for the Crew
tastemadetravel.us.description: As Pati travels with her TV production crew through Mexico, they stop at a hacienda outside of Hermosillo where Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast in the rustic outdoor kitchen - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Nectar of the Mayan Gods
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Yucatán's Most Unique Salts
tastemadetravel.us.description: An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Carne Asada with La Familia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati learns that carne asada goes way beyond grilled meat in Sonora. It's an important weekly ritual that brings the whole family together.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Flour Power
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati tours one of Hermosillo's oldest flour mills and gets a lesson on making coyotas, a traditional dessert, at a local bakery. In her kitchen, Pati shares her take on a classic Sonoran recipe - a carne con chile burrito.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Three Amigos
tastemadetravel.us.description: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Italian Job
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The French Connection
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Mamma Mia! Off We Go Again
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Hacienda Ranch Food
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, and cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with a pickled grape salad. In Sonora, she visits a traditional hacienda, where she gets a true taste of Sonoran ranch food.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Tradition and Innovation
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Pioneering From Farm to Table
tastemadetravel.us.description: Spicy honey, garlic and orange roasted duck; skillet corn tamal with duck fat and roasted garlic.

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs
tastemadetravel.us.description: Wedding rice; ginger and pistachio guacamole.

travel.us.description: Zak Bagans and his crew investigate Los Angeles' infamous hotel, which is steeped in stories of paranormal activity as a result of its checkered past; the team retraces Elisa Lam's steps, including the water tower where she was found. (Specials, Reality TV)

travel.us.description: Chaos follows the crew as they cross the San Francisco Bay to investigate the deceptively named Angel Island; the guys face residual anger emanating from a demonic darkness. (Specials, Reality TV)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Steinbeck House Haunting
travel.us.description: The crew investigates a dark presence at an iconic author's childhood home. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Whitmore Mansion
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew investigate a Utah mansion soaked in tragedy and bloodshed; unexplained paranormal activity has the new owner desperate for answers, and the team is concerned that a portal to hell has unleashed a negative entity into the home. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Montecito Mansion of Mystery
travel.us.description: The crew embark on one of their investigations at a mansion in Montecito, California; this historic home offers up shocking evidence. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Mountain Oaks Mayhem
travel.us.description: The crew investigate rumors of dark forces at an abandoned home in La Crescenta, California, and whether Charles Manson put a curse on the family who lived there. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Petrified in Pahrump
travel.us.description: The crew is in Nevada to investigate a winery that's been plagued by fatal accidents; the terrified staff claim they are being stalked by an evil presence. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Lost Souls of Kingman
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew investigate an Arizona high school plagued by paranormal experiences; exploring if the ghostly activity is linked to an abandoned cemetery or if the victims of a deadly explosion are calling out from beyond the grave. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Old Bullion Plaza School
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew head to an Arizona mining town to investigate a former school where horrendous child abuse took place; the team unlocks the dark secrets that lie entombed in the walls of the building. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Acadia Ranch Sanitorium
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew go far off the beaten path in Arizona to investigate an abandoned sanatorium; dozens of deaths have left a heavy residue of pain and suffering on the building, making it a hotbed for aggressive poltergeist activity. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Henderson Hell House
travel.us.description: Zak and the crew rush to help a Nevada family who claim paranormal activity sent one parent to the hospital, and fear their young daughter is next; the team works to uncover the dark source of the psychological attacks hiding inside the home. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Nightmare at the Roxie
travel.us.description: The crew goes to downtown Los Angeles to investigate the long-abandoned Roxie Theater, the site of a mysterious suicide; the once majestic movie house has been left to rot, making it the perfect refuge for lost souls - and a dark, foreboding energy. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Los Feliz Murder House
travel.us.description: Sixty years after a gruesome murder-suicide in a Los Angeles mansion became urban lore, Zak and the crew gain entry; in the first-ever paranormal investigation of the long-shuttered residence, they uncover shocking secrets and a terrifying presence. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

travel.us.title: Ghost Adventures - Los Feliz Murder House
travel.us.description: Zak and the GAC continue their confrontation with a dark presence that has overtaken the Los Feliz neighborhood's infamous hillside mansion; they conduct an ancient Sumerian ritual to open gates to the other side. (Reality TV, Paranormal)

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Rethinking the Persian Empire
truehistory.us.description: Cyrus, Darius and Xerxes; these Persian kings are sometimes stereotyped as one-dimensional despots in Greek histories; the truth about the Achaemenid Persian Empire; an empire that stretches from Egypt and Asia Minor, all the way to the Indus Valley.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Questioning the Sources
truehistory.us.description: Greek historians provide valuable information about the Persian Empire; the Greek perspective is often negatively biased; archaeology uncovers inscriptions, administrative tablets and other documents that let the Persians speak for themselves.

truehistory.us.title: Understanding Russia: A Cultural History - A Russian Past, the Putin Future
truehistory.us.description: The heart of Russian history and culture; examining many themes; the enormity of Russia's geography; its desire for power; its search for an organic cultural identity; exploring the beginnings of Russia in the land known as Rus'.

truehistory.us.title: Understanding Russia: A Cultural History - Ivan the Terrible's 500-Year Reign
truehistory.us.description: Ivan the Terrible's reign is a cultural and historical symbol of Russian leadership; how he uses cultural symbols to create a spectacle of autocracy; knowing to what extent he sets the standard for subsequent centuries of the Russian leadership.

truehistory.us.title: Herodotus: The Father of History - Herodotus and History
truehistory.us.description: Identifying key issues of definition and terminology; explaining what is known about the life of Herodotus; background on the ancient Greek world; summarizing the momentous events, particularly the Persian Wars, that spur Herodotus to write.

truehistory.us.title: Herodotus: The Father of History - "Inquiry" and the Birth of History
truehistory.us.description: Herodotus is not the first Greek to write about the past; knowing makes him original; how he explains, in the very first sentence of his work and one that richly rewards close reading, the what, why and how of his monumental effort.

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Bearing Off: The Story of Backgammon
truehistory.us.description: During the Third Crusade, the European soldiers spend the winter playing the ancient game of Tables, which would evolve into backgammon by the 20th century.

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Senet: Egypt's Game of the Afterlife
truehistory.us.description: Unearthed artifacts from King Tutankhamun's tomb include Senet boards. Historians study the hieroglyphs and investigate the abrupt disappearance of this ancient Egyptian game.

truehistory.us.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs - Why Egypt Needed Hieroglyphs
truehistory.us.description: Understanding why Ancient Egypt has to invent some form of writing; central to this introduction is a study of the Narmer Palette; its writing sets standards and conventions that would be followed for 3,000 years.

truehistory.us.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs - The Ancient Egyptian Alphabet
truehistory.us.description: Learning the hieroglyphic alphabet; how to write and position each hieroglyph, including a stylized hand, a horned viper and two hieroglyphs for which English does not have a letter; transcribing one's name from English to ancient Egyptian.

truehistory.us.title: World Heritage Sites: Exploring the World's Greatest Places - Paleolithic Cave Art of Spain and France
truehistory.us.description: The oldest paintings in the world, in the extraordinary cave art of Altamira, Lascaux, and Chauvet.

truehistory.us.title: World Heritage Sites: Exploring the World's Greatest Places - The Taj Mahal of Agra
truehistory.us.description: Learning about the builder of Taj, the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan, and his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal, for whom it was built.

truehistory.us.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - Why Strategy Matters
truehistory.us.description: If war is a gamble, then a strategy is key to success; a survey of why strategy is important; looking at World War II's "Operation Torch" as a case study for how the military should be used as an instrument of policy.

truehistory.us.title: Masters of War: History's Greatest Strategic Thinkers - Thucydides On Strategy
truehistory.us.description: A systematic look at what makes Thucydides perhaps history's first great strategist; his analysis of the Peloponnesian War; the political origins of the war; the Spartan and Athenian leadership; the social and moral implications of war.

truehistory.us.title: History's Great Military Blunders and the Lessons They Teach - Petersburg: Union Digs Its Own Grave - 1864
truehistory.us.description: Following the chain of events that led to the Civil War's ill-fated Battle of the Crater; what can happen in warfare when a plan goes awry due to various factors; the phenomenon of military blunders and what they can teach people.

truehistory.us.title: History's Great Military Blunders and the Lessons They Teach - Syracuse: Athens's Second Front - 413 B.C.
truehistory.us.description: From initiating a second front with a new enemy to dividing supreme command among multiple generals; how failures of decision-making and leadership spelled disaster for the Greek city state of Athens in the outcome of the Peloponnesian War.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Rethinking the Persian Empire
truehistory.us.description: Cyrus, Darius and Xerxes; these Persian kings are sometimes stereotyped as one-dimensional despots in Greek histories; the truth about the Achaemenid Persian Empire; an empire that stretches from Egypt and Asia Minor, all the way to the Indus Valley.

truehistory.us.title: The Persian Empire - Questioning the Sources
truehistory.us.description: Greek historians provide valuable information about the Persian Empire; the Greek perspective is often negatively biased; archaeology uncovers inscriptions, administrative tablets and other documents that let the Persians speak for themselves.

truehistory.us.title: Understanding Russia: A Cultural History - A Russian Past, the Putin Future
truehistory.us.description: The heart of Russian history and culture; examining many themes; the enormity of Russia's geography; its desire for power; its search for an organic cultural identity; exploring the beginnings of Russia in the land known as Rus'.

truehistory.us.title: Understanding Russia: A Cultural History - Ivan the Terrible's 500-Year Reign
truehistory.us.description: Ivan the Terrible's reign is a cultural and historical symbol of Russian leadership; how he uses cultural symbols to create a spectacle of autocracy; knowing to what extent he sets the standard for subsequent centuries of the Russian leadership.

truehistory.us.title: Herodotus: The Father of History - Herodotus and History
truehistory.us.description: Identifying key issues of definition and terminology; explaining what is known about the life of Herodotus; background on the ancient Greek world; summarizing the momentous events, particularly the Persian Wars, that spur Herodotus to write.

truehistory.us.title: Notorious London: A City Tour - Oscar Wilde's Decadent London
truehistory.us.description: London when it is home to Oscar Wilde at the close of the 19th century; the details of Wilde's trial for indecency; the way London society is structured; how immense wealth and privilege, for some, leaves its imprint on the city and its history.

truehistory.us.title: Notorious London: A City Tour - St. Paul's Cathedral in Faith, Fire, and Sin
truehistory.us.description: St. Paul's Cathedral has overlooked London from a high point in the city for generations; the history of this church that has been much more than a place of worship; it has survived fire and the ravages of war; episodes from the cathedral's past.

truehistory.us.title: Notorious London: A City Tour - Getting Blitzed at London's Café de Paris
truehistory.us.description: An evening in March 1941, when the Café de Paris is destroyed in the Blitz; the history of the café; how its destruction reflects the horrors of wartime London; the resiliency of the citizens who keep calm and carry on under the threat of war.

truehistory.us.title: Notorious London: A City Tour - On Carnaby Street during the Swinging '60s
truehistory.us.description: Carnaby Street emerges in the 17th century; a symbol of social change in the 1960s; its history; it becomes a magnet for trendsetters and youth culture in post-war London; why these changes are embraced by some and seen as a threat by others.
